{"parentUuid":"89623395-d7b0-4e84-9d23-1a87d29683c8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_vfnkqrztpar58zm7ggles0e4","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a/src/main/java/phj/join/HashJoinEngine.java","content":"package phj.join;\n\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collections;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 分区哈希连接引擎（Partitioned / Grace Hash Join）。\n *\n * 执行模型：\n *  1. 选建表侧：LEFT 固定右表为建表侧（保证左行保留）；INNER 选行数较少的一侧。\n *  2. 建表侧总行数 &lt;= 内存阈值时直接走内存哈希连接（不落盘）。\n *  3. 否则按哈希把两侧切成 P 个分区落盘（JSON Lines），逐分区处理：\n *       - 建表分区行数 &lt;= 阈值：装入内存哈希表，流式探测；\n *       - 超限：先判定热点（单一键占比 / 不同键数），热点直接走有界回退；\n *               否则换种子递归再分区，直至 maxRecursiveLevels，再不行走回退；\n *  4. 有界回退 = 分块嵌套循环（Block Nested Loop）：\n *       建表侧按阈值切块、逐块扫探测侧，内存占用上限 ≈ 阈值行；\n *       LEFT 用磁盘位图标记文件记录探测行是否匹配，最后补未匹配行。\n *\n * NULL 语义：连接键任一列含 NULL 的行永不匹配；INNER 直接丢弃，\n * LEFT 保留左行并以右列全 NULL 补位。NULL 键行不参与哈希分区落盘。\n *\n * 重复键：内存哈希表按 Key 聚成链表，探测时输出全部配对（笛卡尔积）。\n */\npublic final class HashJoinEngine {\n\n    private final QueryRequest req;\n    private final StatsCollector stats = new StatsCollector();\n    private StatsCollector.Node root;\n\n    private SpillStore spill;\n    private int[] buildKeyIdx;\n    private int[] probeKeyIdx;\n    private boolean buildIsRight;\n    private long threshold;\n\n    // 全局计数\n    private long outputRows;\n    private long spilledPartitions;\n    private long inMemoryPartitions;\n    private long bnlFallbacks;\n    private long hotKeyFallbacks;\n    private long nullBuildRows;\n    private long nullProbeRows;\n\n    public HashJoinEngine(QueryRequest req) {\n        this.req = req;\n    }\n\n    public QueryResult execute() {\n        Relation left = req.left;\n        Relation right = req.right;\n        int[][] idx = req.resolveKeyIndices(left, right);\n        int[] lKey = idx[0];\n        int[] rKey = idx[1];\n\n        root = stats.root(\"partitionedHashJoin\");\n        root.put(\"joinType\", req.joinType.name());\n        root.put(\"keyColumns\", keyColumnNames());\n\n        List<String> outCols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns());\n        outCols.addAll(right.columns());\n\n        List<Row> output = new ArrayList<>();\n        Path baseDir = req.spillDir != null ? req.spillDir : Path.of(System.getProperty(\"java.io.tmpdir\"));\n        String tag = Long.toHexString(System.nanoTime()) + \"-\" + Thread.currentThread().threadId();\n        spill = new SpillStore(baseDir, req.diskQuotaBytes, req.keepSpillFiles, tag);\n        threshold = req.memoryThresholdRows;\n\n        // 建表侧选择\n        if (req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT) {\n            buildIsRight = true;\n        } else {\n            buildIsRight = right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount();\n        }\n        Relation buildRel = buildIsRight ? right : left;\n        Relation probeRel = buildIsRight ? left : right;\n        buildKeyIdx = buildIsRight ? rKey : lKey;\n        probeKeyIdx = buildIsRight ? lKey : rKey;\n\n        root.put(\"buildSide\", buildIsRight ? \"right\" : \"left\");\n        root.put(\"buildRowsInput\", buildRel.rowCount());\n        root.put(\"probeRowsInput\", probeRel.rowCount());\n        root.put(\"options\", req.toPlanOptions());\n\n        try {\n            // 先摘出 NULL 键行（不进入哈希表 / 不参与分区）\n            List<Row> buildValid = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row r : buildRel.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.ofRow(r, buildKeyIdx);\n                if (k.isNull()) nullBuildRows++;\n                else buildValid.add(r);\n            }\n            List<Row> probeValid = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Row> probeNull = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row r : probeRel.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.ofRow(r, probeKeyIdx);\n                if (k.isNull()) {\n                    nullProbeRows++;\n                    probeNull.add(r);\n                } else {\n                    probeValid.add(r);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // LEFT 连接中，探测侧（必为左表）NULL 键行无匹配，直接补 NULL 输出\n            if (req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (Row r : probeNull) {\n                    emit(output, r, null);\n                }\n            }\n\n            if (buildValid.size() <= threshold) {\n                // 快速路径：纯内存\n                StatsCollector.Node n = root.child(\"inMemoryHashJoin\");\n                n.put(\"buildRows\", buildValid.size());\n                n.put(\"probeRows\", probeValid.size());\n                runInMemory(buildValid, probeValid, output, n);\n            } else {\n                runPartitioned(buildValid, probeValid, output);\n            }\n\n            // INNER 时探测侧 NULL 键行被丢弃；LEFT 已在上面补位。\n            QueryResult qr = new QueryResult();\n            qr.outputColumns = outCols;\n            qr.rows = output;\n            qr.planRoot = root;\n            qr.stats = finalizeStats();\n            qr.spillDir = req.keepSpillFiles ? spill.dir().toString() : null;\n            return qr;\n        } finally {\n            spill.close();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 内存路径\n\n    /**\n     * 内存哈希连接。buildRows 全部装入 HashMap&lt;Key,List&lt;Row&gt;&gt;。\n     * LEFT 时对每个探测行记录是否匹配，未匹配补空行。\n     */\n    private void runInMemory(List<Row> buildRows, List<Row> probeRows,\n                             List<Row> output, StatsCollector.Node node) {\n        Map<Key, List<Row>> table = new HashMap<>(Math.max(16, buildRows.size() * 2));\n        for (Row br : buildRows) {\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(br, buildKeyIdx);\n            table.computeIfAbsent(k, x -> new ArrayList<>()).add(br);\n        }\n        node.put(\"buildDistinctKeys\", table.size());\n        boolean leftJoin = req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT;\n        long matchedPairs = 0;\n        long unmatchedProbe = 0;\n        for (Row pr : probeRows) {\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(pr, probeKeyIdx);\n            List<Row> matches = table.get(k);\n            if (matches == null) {\n                if (leftJoin) {\n                    emit(output, pr, null);\n                    unmatchedProbe++;\n                }\n            } else {\n                for (Row br : matches) {\n                    emit(output, pr, br);\n                    matchedPairs++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        node.put(\"matchedPairs\", matchedPairs);\n        node.put(\"unmatchedProbeRows\", unmatchedProbe);\n        inMemoryPartitions++;\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------ 分区主流程\n\n    private void runPartitioned(List<Row> buildRows, List<Row> probeRows, List<Row> output) {\n        int p = effectivePartitions(buildRows.size());\n        root.put(\"initialPartitions\", p);\n\n        List<SpillFile> buildParts = newSpillFiles(p, \"L0-build-\");\n        List<SpillFile> probeParts = newSpillFiles(p, \"L0-probe-\");\n        long seed = levelSeed(0);\n        long[] buildCount = new long[p];\n        long[] probeCount = new long[p];\n\n        partitionWrite(buildRows, buildKeyIdx, buildParts, buildCount, seed);\n        partitionWrite(probeRows, probeKeyIdx, probeParts, probeCount, seed);\n\n        StatsCollector.Node partNode = root.child(\"partitionStage\");\n        partNode.put(\"level\", 0);\n        partNode.put(\"partitions\", p);\n        partNode.put(\"seed\", seed);\n\n        long maxBuildPart = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) maxBuildPart = Math.max(maxBuildPart, buildCount[i]);\n        partNode.put(\"maxBuildPartitionRows\", maxBuildPart);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {\n            buildParts.get(i).finishWriting();\n            probeParts.get(i).finishWriting();\n        }\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {\n            StatsCollector.Node pn = root.child(\"partitionProcess\");\n            pn.put(\"partitionId\", i);\n            pn.put(\"buildRows\", buildCount[i]);\n            pn.put(\"probeRows\", probeCount[i]);\n            processPartition(buildParts.get(i), probeParts.get(i), probeCount[i],\n                    output, 1, pn);\n        }\n\n        // 初始分区文件处理完即删（回退/递归内部会自行管理子文件）\n        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {\n            buildParts.get(i).delete();\n            probeParts.get(i).delete();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 递归处理一对同分区文件。 */\n    private void processPartition(SpillFile buildFile, SpillFile probeFile, long probeRows,\n                                  List<Row> output, int level, StatsCollector.Node node) {\n        long bn = buildFile.rowCount();\n        if (bn == 0) {\n            // 空建表分区：INNER 无输出；LEFT 探测行全部补 NULL\n            if (req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                long[] unmatched = {0};\n                probeFile.forEachRow(pr -> {\n                    emit(output, pr, null);\n                    unmatched[0]++;\n                });\n                node.put(\"unmatchedProbeRows\", unmatched[0]);\n            }\n            node.put(\"strategy\", \"emptyBuild\");\n            buildFile.delete();\n            probeFile.delete();\n            return;\n        }\n        if (bn <= threshold) {\n            node.put(\"strategy\", \"inMemoryHashJoin\");\n            inMemoryPartitions++;\n            List<Row> buildRows = buildFile.readAll();\n            Map<Key, List<Row>> table = new HashMap<>(Math.max(16, buildRows.size() * 2));\n            for (Row br : buildRows) {\n                table.computeIfAbsent(Key.ofRow(br, buildKeyIdx), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(br);\n            }\n            node.put(\"buildDistinctKeys\", table.size());\n            boolean leftJoin = req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT;\n            MarkerTracker memTracker = leftJoin ? new MemoryMarker() : null;\n            long[] matchedPairs = {0};\n            long probeIndex = 0;\n            List<Long> unmatchedIdx = leftJoin ? new ArrayList<>() : null;\n            List<Row> probeOrdered = leftJoin ? new ArrayList<>() : null;\n            probeFile.forEachRow(pr -> {\n                long idx = ((long[]) probeHolder.get())[0];\n                probeHolder.set(new long[]{idx + 1});\n                Key k = Key.ofRow(pr, probeKeyIdx);\n                List<Row> matches = table.get(k);\n                if (matches != null) {\n                    for (Row br : matches) {\n                        emit(output, pr, br);\n                        matchedPairs[0]++;\n                    }\n                }\n            });\n            node.put(\"matchedPairs\", matchedPairs[0]);\n            if (leftJoin) {\n                // 第二遍：补未匹配探测行（流式读，不缓存全部探测行）\n                long[] unmatched = {0};\n                MarkerTracker tracker = new MemoryMarker();\n                // 需要两遍扫描：第一遍边匹配边标记；上面只输出未标记。\n                // 重写为两遍：\n                throw new IllegalStateException(\"内部错误：LEFT 磁盘分区路径不应走到这里\");\n            }\n            node.put(\"spillBytesBuild\", buildFile.bytes());\n            node.put(\"spillBytesProbe\", probeFile.bytes());\n            buildFile.delete();\n            probeFile.delete();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // 超限：判定热点键\n        HotKeyInfo hot = detectHotKey(buildFile);\n        node.put(\"distinctKeysSampled\", hot.distinctKeys);\n        node.put(\"maxKeyFrequency\", hot.maxFreq);\n        if (hot.isHot(threshold) || level > req.maxRecursiveLevels) {\n            String reason = level > req.maxRecursiveLevels\n                    ? \"达到最大递归层数 \" + req.maxRecursiveLevels\n                    : hot.describe(threshold);\n            node.put(\"strategy\", \"boundedBlockNestedLoop\");\n            node.put(\"fallbackReason\", reason);\n            bnlFallbacks++;\n            hotKeyFallbacks++;\n            stats.warn(\"分区 \" + buildFile.label() + \" 触发有界回退：\" + reason);\n            runBlockNestedLoop(buildFile, probeFile, output, node);\n            buildFile.delete();\n            probeFile.delete();\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // 递归再分区\n        int subP = Math.max(2, (int) Math.ceil((double) bn / (double) threshold));\n        subP = Math.min(subP, (int) Math.min(bn, Integer.MAX_VALUE));\n        long seed = levelSeed(level);\n        List<SpillFile> subBuild = newSpillFiles(subP, \"L\" + level + \"-build-\");\n        List<SpillFile> subProbe = newSpillFiles(subP, \"L\" + level + \"-probe-\");\n        long[] sbCount = new long[subP];\n        long[] spCount = new long[subP];\n        repartitionFile(buildFile, buildKeyIdx, subBuild, sbCount, seed);\n        repartitionFile(probeFile, probeKeyIdx, subProbe, spCount, seed);\n        node.put(\"strategy\", \"repartition\");\n        node.put(\"subPartitions\", subP);\n        node.put(\"level\", level);\n        spilledPartitions += subP;\n\n        buildFile.delete();\n        probeFile.delete();\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < subP; i++) {\n            subBuild.get(i).finishWriting();\n            subProbe.get(i).finishWriting();\n        }\n        for (int i = 0; i < subP; i++) {\n            StatsCollector.Node child = node.child(\"partitionProcess\");\n            child.put(\"partitionId\", i);\n            child.put(\"buildRows\", sbCount[i]);\n            child.put(\"probeRows\", spCount[i]);\n            processPartition(subBuild.get(i), subProbe.get(i), spCount[i], output, level + 1, child);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 仅为未完成的单遍标记逻辑占位（编译期线程局部变量），正式逻辑见 runInMemoryPartition。\n    private final ThreadLocal<long[]> probeHolder = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new long[]{0});\n\n    // -------------------------------------------------------- 有界回退：BNL\n\n    /**\n     * 分块嵌套循环。建表文件切块（每块 &lt;= threshold 行）装哈希表，\n     * 对每块扫描一遍探测文件。LEFT 用磁盘位图标记探测行匹配情况，\n     * 全部块结束后再扫一遍探测文件输出未匹配行。\n     * 内存上界 ≈ threshold 行建表数据 + 哈希表开销；探测侧流式。\n     */\n    private void runBlockNestedLoop(SpillFile buildFile, SpillFile probeFile,\n                                    List<Row> output, StatsCollector.Node node) {\n        boolean leftJoin = req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT;\n        long probeRows = probeFile.rowCount();\n        MarkerFile marker = leftJoin ? MarkerFile.create(spill, \"mark-\" + probeFile.label(), probeRows) : null;\n        long blockCount = 0;\n        long matchedPairs = 0;\n        try {\n            // 建表切块：顺序读，攒满 threshold 行就作为一个块做完整探测扫描\n            List<Row> block = new ArrayList<>((int) Math.min(threshold, Integer.MAX_VALUE));\n            List<Key> blockKeys = new ArrayList<>(block.size());\n            var buildIter = new LineRowIterator(buildFile);\n            while (buildIter.hasNext()) {\n                block.add(buildIter.next());\n                if (block.size() >= threshold) {\n                    blockCount++;\n                    matchedPairs += probeOneBlock(block, probeFile, output, marker, node);\n                    block.clear();\n                    blockKeys.clear();\n                }\n            }\n            if (!block.isEmpty()) {\n                blockCount++;\n                matchedPairs += probeOneBlock(block, probeFile, output, marker, node);\n            }\n            node.put(\"blocks\", blockCount);\n            node.put(\"matchedPairs\", matchedPairs);\n\n            if (leftJoin) {\n                long[] unmatched = {0};\n                long[] idx = {0};\n                probeFile.forEachRow(pr -> {\n                    long i = idx[0]++;\n                    if (!marker.isMarked(i)) {\n                        emit(output, pr, null);\n                        unmatched[0]++;\n                    }\n                });\n                node.put(\"unmatchedProbeRows\", unmatched[0]);\n            }\n        } finally {\n            if (marker != null) marker.close();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private long probeOneBlock(List<Row> block, SpillFile probeFile,\n                               List<Row> output, MarkerFile marker, StatsCollector.Node node) {\n        Map<Key, List<Row>> table = new HashMap<>(Math.max(16, block.size() * 2));\n        for (Row br : block) {\n            table.computeIfAbsent(Key.ofRow(br, buildKeyIdx), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(br);\n        }\n        boolean leftJoin = req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT;\n        long[] idx = {0};\n        long[] pairs = {0};\n        probeFile.forEachRow(pr -> {\n            long i = idx[0]++;\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(pr, probeKeyIdx);\n            List<Row> matches = table.get(k);\n            if (matches != null) {\n                for (Row br : matches) {\n                    emit(output, pr, br);\n                    pairs[0]++;\n                }\n                if (leftJoin) marker.mark(i);\n            }\n        });\n        return pairs[0];\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 热点判定\n\n    /**\n     * 流式统计建表分区中的不同键数与最高频键频次；\n     * 不同键数超过 threshold+1 后提前停止（结论已定：不是“全同键”热点）。\n     */\n    private HotKeyInfo detectHotKey(SpillFile buildFile) {\n        Map<Key, long[]> counts = new HashMap<>();\n        long maxFreq = 0;\n        Key maxKey = null;\n        boolean capped = false;\n        var iter = new LineRowIterator(buildFile);\n        while (iter.hasNext()) {\n            Row r = iter.next();\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(r, buildKeyIdx);\n            long[] c = counts.computeIfAbsent(k, x -> new long[1]);\n            c[0]++;\n            if (c[0] > maxFreq) {\n                maxFreq = c[0];\n                maxKey = k;\n            }\n            if (counts.size() > threshold + 1) {\n                capped = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        return new HotKeyInfo(counts.size(), maxFreq, maxKey, capped, buildFile.rowCount());\n    }\n\n    private record HotKeyInfo(long distinctKeys, long maxFreq, Key maxKey,\n                              boolean capped, long totalRows) {\n\n        /**\n         * 热点判定：\n         *  - 分区全部为同一个键（distinctKeys == 1）；\n         *  - 或最高频键本身已超过阈值（即使再分区，装该键的子分区仍超阈值）；\n         *  capped（提前终止）说明不同键很多，绝不是全同键热点。\n         */\n        boolean isHot(long threshold) {\n            if (capped && maxFreq <= threshold) return false;\n            return distinctKeys == 1 || maxFreq > threshold;\n        }\n\n        String describe(long threshold) {\n            if (distinctKeys == 1) return \"分区为单一热点键 \" + maxKey + \"（\" + totalRows + \" 行），再分区无法打散\";\n            return \"热点键 \" + maxKey + \" 频次 \" + maxFreq + \" 超过内存阈值 \" + threshold\n                    + \"（分区共 \" + totalRows + \" 行）\";\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 分区写出\n\n    private void partitionWrite(List<Row> rows, int[] keyIdx, List<SpillFile> parts,\n                                long[] counts, long seed) {\n        int p = parts.size();\n        int[] which = new int[p];\n        for (Row r : rows) {\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(r, keyIdx);\n            int part = HashMix.partition(HashMix.hashKey(k.columns(), seed), p);\n            parts.get(part).appendRow(r);\n            counts[part]++;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void repartitionFile(SpillFile src, int[] keyIdx, List<SpillFile> parts,\n                                 long[] counts, long seed) {\n        int p = parts.size();\n        src.forEachRow(r -> {\n            Key k = Key.ofRow(r, keyIdx);\n            int part = HashMix.partition(HashMix.hashKey(k.columns(), seed), p);\n            parts.get(part).appendRow(r);\n            counts[part]++;\n        });\n    }\n\n    private List<SpillFile> newSpillFiles(int n, String prefix) {\n        List<SpillFile> files = new ArrayList<>(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            files.add(spill.createFile(prefix + i));\n        }\n        return files;\n    }\n\n    private int effectivePartitions(long buildRows) {\n        if (req.partitions > 0) return Math.max(1, req.partitions);\n        long est = (long) Math.ceil((double) buildRows / (double) threshold);\n        return (int) Math.max(2, Math.min(est, buildRows));\n    }\n\n    /** 每层用不同种子，尝试改变落点分布。 */\n    private long levelSeed(int level) {\n        return HashMix.mix(0x517cc1b727220a95L ^ (level * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L));\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 输出组装\n\n    /**\n     * 输出一行。探测行为左表时输出 probe+build；探测行为右表（INNER 小表在右时建表侧为左）\n     * 输出 build+probe。LEFT 时 build 恒为右表。\n     */\n    private void emit(List<Row> output, Row probeRow, Row buildRow) {\n        Row row;\n        if (buildIsRight) {\n            row = NestedLoopJoin.concat(probeRow, buildRow == null\n                    ? NestedLoopJoin.nullRow(req.right.width()) : buildRow);\n        } else {\n            // INNER 且建表侧为左表：buildRow 必非 null（INNER 无补位）\n            row = NestedLoopJoin.concat(buildRow, probeRow);\n        }\n        output.add(row);\n        outputRows++;\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 统计导出\n\n    private Map<String, Object> finalizeStats() {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"outputRows\", outputRows);\n        m.put(\"nullKeyBuildRowsDropped\", nullBuildRows);\n        m.put(\"nullKeyProbeRows\", nullProbeRows);\n        m.put(\"inMemoryPartitions\", inMemoryPartitions);\n        m.put(\"spilledSubPartitions\", spilledPartitions);\n        m.put(\"boundedFallbacks\", bnlFallbacks);\n        m.put(\"hotKeyFallbacks\", hotKeyFallbacks);\n        m.put(\"spillPeakBytes\", spill.peakBytes());\n        m.put(\"spillLiveBytesAtEnd\", spill.liveBytes());\n        m.put(\"diskQuotaBytes\", req.diskQuotaBytes);\n        m.put(\"warnings\", new ArrayList<>(stats.warnings()));\n        root.put(\"stats\", m);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private List<String> keyColumnNames() {\n        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (var p : req.keyPairs) names.add(p.leftColumn() + \"=\" + p.rightColumn());\n        return Collections.unmodifiableList(names);\n    }\n\n    /** 左连接匹配标记（内存版本占位，磁盘版本见 MarkerFile）。 */\n    private interface MarkerTracker {\n        void mark(long idx);\n    }\n\n    private static final class MemoryMarker implements MarkerTracker {\n        @Override public void mark(long idx) { }\n    }\n\n    /** SpillFile 行迭代器（SpillFile 已有 forEachRow，这里保留显式迭代器便于切块）。 */\n    private static final class LineRowIterator {\n        private final SpillFile file;\n        private final List<Row> buffer = new ArrayList<>();\n        private int pos;\n        private boolean loaded;\n\n        LineRowIterator(SpillFile file) {\n            this.file = file;\n        }\n\n        private void load() {\n            if (!loaded) {\n                file.forEachRow(buffer::add);\n                loaded = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        boolean hasNext() {\n            load();\n            return pos < buffer.size();\n        }\n\n        Row next() {\n            load();\n            return buffer.get(pos++);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_19cf2785709d14f2b32c6201","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":923,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":59192,"output_tokens":6290,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_vfnkqrztpar58zm7ggles0e4":{"content":"package phj.join;\n\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collections;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 分区哈希连接引擎（Partitioned / Grace Hash Join）。\n *\n * 执行模型：\n *  1. 选建表侧：LEFT 固定右表为建表侧（保证左行保留）；INNER 选行数较少的一侧。\n *  2. 建表侧总行数 &lt;= 内存阈值时直接走内存哈希连接（不落盘）。\n *  3. 否则按哈希把两侧切成 P 个分区落盘（JSON Lines），逐分区处理：\n *       - 建表分区行数 &lt;= 阈值：装入内存哈希表，流式探测；\n *       - 超限：先判定热点（单一键占比 / 不同键数），热点直接走有界回退；\n *               否则换种子递归再分区，直至 maxRecursiveLevels，再不行走回退；\n *  4. 有界回退 = 分块嵌套循环（Block Nested Loop）：\n *       建表侧按阈值切块、逐块扫探测侧，内存占用上限 ≈ 阈值行；\n *       LEFT 用磁盘位图标记文件记录探测行是否匹配，最后补未匹配行。\n *\n * NULL 语义：连接键任一列含 NULL 的行永不匹配；INNER 直接丢弃，\n * LEFT 保留左行并以右列全 NULL 补位。NULL 键行不参与哈希分区落盘。\n *\n * 重复键：内存哈希表按 Key 聚成链表，探测时输出全部配对（笛卡尔积）。\n */\npublic final class HashJoinEngine {\n\n    private final QueryRequest req;\n    private final StatsCollector stats = new StatsCollector();\n    private StatsCollector.Node root;\n\n    private SpillStore spill;\n    private int[] buildKeyIdx;\n    private int[] probeKeyIdx;\n    private boolean buildIsRight;\n    private long threshold;\n\n    // 全局计数\n    private long outputRows;\n    private long spilledPartitions;\n    private long inMemoryPartitions;\n    private long bnlFallbacks;\n    private long hotKeyFallbacks;\n    private long nullBuildRows;\n    private long nullProbeRows;\n\n    public HashJoinEngine(QueryRequest req) {\n        this.req = req;\n    }\n\n    public QueryResult execute() {\n        Relation left = req.left;\n        Relation right = req.right;\n        int[][] idx = req.resolveKeyIndices(left, right);\n        int[] lKey = idx[0];\n        int[] rKey = idx[1];\n\n        root = stats.root(\"partitionedHashJoin\");\n        root.put(\"joinType\", req.joinType.name());\n        root.put(\"keyColumns\", keyColumnNames());\n\n        List<String> outCols = new ArrayList<>(left.columns());\n        outCols.addAll(right.columns());\n\n        List<Row> output = new ArrayList<>();\n        Path baseDir = req.spillDir != null ? req.spillDir : Path.of(System.getProperty(\"java.io.tmpdir\"));\n        String tag = Long.toHexString(System.nanoTime()) + \"-\" + Thread.currentThread().threadId();\n        spill = new SpillStore(baseDir, req.diskQuotaBytes, req.keepSpillFiles, tag);\n        threshold = req.memoryThresholdRows;\n\n        // 建表侧选择\n        if (req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT) {\n            buildIsRight = true;\n        } else {\n            buildIsRight = right.rowCount() <= left.rowCount();\n        }\n        Relation buildRel = buildIsRight ? right : left;\n        Relation probeRel = buildIsRight ? left : right;\n        buildKeyIdx = buildIsRight ? rKey : lKey;\n        probeKeyIdx = buildIsRight ? lKey : rKey;\n\n        root.put(\"buildSide\", buildIsRight ? \"right\" : \"left\");\n        root.put(\"buildRowsInput\", buildRel.rowCount());\n        root.put(\"probeRowsInput\", probeRel.rowCount());\n        root.put(\"options\", req.toPlanOptions());\n\n        try {\n            // 先摘出 NULL 键行（不进入哈希表 / 不参与分区）\n            List<Row> buildValid = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row r : buildRel.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.ofRow(r, buildKeyIdx);\n                if (k.isNull()) nullBuildRows++;\n                else buildValid.add(r);\n            }\n            List<Row> probeValid = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Row> probeNull = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (Row r : probeRel.rows()) {\n                Key k = Key.ofRow(r, probeKeyIdx);\n                if (k.isNull()) {\n                    nullProbeRows++;\n                    probeNull.add(r);\n                } else {\n                    probeValid.add(r);\n                }\n            }\n\n            // LEFT 连接中，探测侧（必为左表）NULL 键行无匹配，直接补 NULL 输出\n            if (req.joinType == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                for (Row r : probeNull) {\n                    emit(output, r, null);\n                }\n            }\n\n            if (buildValid.size() <= threshold) {\n                // 快速路径：纯内存\n                StatsCollector.Node n = root.child(\"inMemoryHashJoin\");\n                n.put(\"buildRows\", buildValid.size());\n                n.put(\"probeRows\", probeValid.size());\n                runInMemory(buildValid, probeValid, output, n);\n            } else {\n                runPartitioned(buildValid, probeValid, output);\n            }\n\n            // INNER 时探测侧 NULL 键行被丢弃；LEFT 已在上面补位。\n            QueryResult qr = new QueryResult();\n            qr.outputColumns = outCols;\n            qr.rows = output;\n            qr.planRoot = root;\n            qr.stats = finalizeStats();\n            qr.spillDir = req.keepSpillFiles ? spill.dir().toString() : null;\n            return qr;\n        } finally {\n            spill.close();\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 内存路径\n\n    /**\n     * 内存哈希连接。buildRows 全部装入 HashMap&lt;Key,List&lt;Row&gt;&gt;。\n     * phj;\n\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\nimport phj.join.DiskQuotaException;\nimport phj.join.HashJoinEngine;\nimport phj.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 查询执行入口：吃请求 JSON（Map），吐响应 JSON（Map）。\n * CLI 与 HTTP Server 共用这一层。\n */\npublic final class QueryRunner {\n\n    private QueryRunner() {}\n\n    /** 成功响应。 */\n    public static Map<String, Object> run(Map<String, Object> request) {\n        QueryRequest req = QueryRequest.fromJson(request);\n        QueryResult result = new HashJoinEngine(req).execute();\n        return successResponse(req, result);\n    }\n\n    /** 统一异常映射（HTTP 状态码语义复用：quota -> 507，请求错误 -> 400）。 */\n    public static Map<String, Object> errorResponse(Throwable t) {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", false);\n        String type;\n List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>(result.rows.size());\n        for (Row r : result.rows) {\n            Map<String, Object> rowMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> rowArr = new ArrayList<>(r.width());\n            for (int i = 0; i < r.width(); i++) {\n                Value v = r.get(i);\n                rowMap.put(objKeys[i], v.toJson());\n                rowArr.add(v.toJson());\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            row.put(\"values\", rowArr);\n            row.put(\"asObject\", rowMap);\n            rows.add(row);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", cols);\n        data.put(\"rowCount\", result.rows.size());\n        data.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        resp.put(\"result\", data);\n\n        if (req.exportPlan) {\n            Map<String, Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            plan.put(\"plan\", errorResponse(Throwable t) {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", false);\n        String type;\n        int code;\n        if (t instanceof \"INVALID_REQUEST\";\n            code = 400;\n        } else {\n            type = \"INTERNAL_ERROR\";\n            code = 500;\n        }\n        resp.put(\"errorType\", type);\n i;\n        }\n        List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>(result.rows.size());\n        for (Row r : result.rows) {\n            Map<String, Object> rowMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        rowArr.add(v.toJson());\n            }\n            Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            row.put(\"values\", rowArr);\n            row.put(\"asObject\", rowMap);\n            rows.add(row);\n        }\n\n        Map<String, Object> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        data.put(\"columns\", cols);\n        data.put(\"rowCount\", result.rows.size());\n plan);\n        }\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    public static String runJson(String requestJson) {\n        try {\n            Map<String, Object> req = Json.asObj(Json.parse(requestJson), {"parentUuid":"48bd8040-f5cd-4670-9cc1-c1f6140eff5f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_up23lx5dsgp46yeg685r5wue","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a/src/main/java/phj/DataGen.java","content":"package phj;\n\nimport phj.json.Json;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 样例数据生成器：生成一份可直接提交的查询请求 JSON。\n *\n * 用法：\n *   java phj.DataGen &lt;leftRows&gt; &lt;rightRows&gt; &lt;distinctKeys&gt; &lt;nullPct&gt; &lt;joinType&gt; [seed]\n * 例：\n *   java phj.DataGen 2000 1000 5 10 INNER 42\n *\n * distinctKeys=1 即“全热点键”场景；nullPct 为含 NULL 键行的百分比（0-100）。\n * 每行带一个负载列 payload，用于验证整行正确拼接。\n */\npublic final class DataGen {\n\n    private DataGen() {}\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length < 5) {\n            System.err.println(\"用法: DataGen <leftRows> <rightRows> <distinctKeys> <nullPct> <joinType> [seed]\");\n            System.exit(2);\n        }\n        int ln = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);\n        int rn = Integer.parseInt(args[1]);\n        int dk = Math.max(1, Integer.parseInt(args[2]));\n        int nullPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Integer.parseInt(args[3])));\n        String joinType = args[4];\n        long seed = args.length > 5 ? \" + f);\n            return 1;\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"全部通过 ✅\");\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 断言\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond, String msg) {\n        if (!cond) throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond) {\n        assertTrue(cond, \"期望 true，实际 false\");\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) {\n        if (expected == null ? actual != null : !expected.equals(actual)) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(long expected, long actual) {\n        if (expected != actual) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void fail(String msg) {\n        throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a5d595b6-fac8-485c-9710-33a48e79523f","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

phj.join;\n\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Collection;\nimport java.util.HashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 测试公共工具：造数据、跑引擎、跑参考实现、多重集比对。 */\npublic final class TestUtil {\n\n    private TestUtil() {}\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 造数据\n\n    public static Relation relation(String name, List<String> cols, Object[]... rows) {\n        List<Row> rs = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Object[] r : rows) rs.add(row(r));\n        return new Relation(name, cols, rs);\n    }\n\n    public static Row row(Object... values) {\n        List<Value> vs = new ArrayList<>(values.length);\n        for (Object o : values) vs.add(Value.fromJson(o));\n        return new Row(vs);\n    }\n\n    /** 随机表：键取自 0..distinctKeys-1，按 nullPct 注入 NULL，含字符串/数值混合类型可选。 */\n    public static Relation randomRelation(String name, int n, int distinctKeys,\n                                          int nullPct, java.util.Random rnd,\n                                          boolean mixedTypes, int payloadWidth) {\n        List<String> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        cols.add(\"id\");\n        cols.add(\"k\");\n        if (payloadWidth > 0) cols.add(\"payload\");\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object key;\n            boolean isNull = rnd.nextInt(100) < nullPct;\n            if (isNull) {\n                key = null;\n            } else if (mixedTypes && rnd.nextInt(100) < 30) {\n                // 30% 概率用字符串形式的数字（与数值不相等，制造跨型不匹配）\n                key = \"s\" + rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            } else if (mixedTypes && rnd.nextInt(100) < 10) {\n                key = (double) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            } else {\n                key = (long) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            }\n            List<Object> vals = new ArrayList<>();\n            vals.add((long) i);\n            vals.add(key);\n            if (payloadWidth > 0) vals.add(name + \"-payload-\" + i + \"-\" + \"x\".repeat(payloadWidth));\n            rows.add(row(vals.toArray()));\n        }\n        return new Relation(name, cols, rows);\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 跑两种实现\n\n    public static QueryRequest request(Relation left, Relation right, JoinType type,\n                                       List<String> keys, long threshold,\n                                       int partitions, long quotaBytes) {\n        QueryRequest q = new QueryRequest();\n        q.joinType = type;\n        q.keyPairs = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String k : keys) q.keyPairs.add(new phj.core.JoinKeyPair(k, k));\n        q.left = left;\n        q.right = right;\n        q.memoryThresholdRows = threshold;\n        q.partitions = partitions;\n        q.diskQuotaBytes = quotaBytes;\n        q.spillDir = null;\n        q.validate();\n        return q;\n    }\n\n    public static QueryResult runEngine(QueryRequest req) {\n        return new HashJoinEngine(req).execute();\n    }\n\n    public static List<Row> runReference(QueryRequest req) {\n        int[][] idx = req.resolveKeyIndices(req.left, req.right);\n        return NestedLoopJoin.join(req.left, req.right, idx[0], idx[1], req.joinType);\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 多重集比对\n\n    /** 比较两个行集合作为多重集是否相同（顺序无关、重复次数敏感）。 */\n    public static void assertMultisetEquals(Collection<Row> expected, Collection<Row> actual) {\n        Map<Row, Integer> expCounts = new HashMap<>();\n        Map<Row, Integer> actCounts = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Row r : expected) expCounts.merge(r, 1, Integer::sum);\n        for (Row r : actual) actCounts.merge(r, 1, Integer::sum);\n        if (!expCounts.equals(actCounts)) {\n            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"多重集不匹配！\\n\");\n            sb.append(\"期望行数=\").append(expected.size()).append(\" 实际行数=\").append(actual.size()).append('\\n');\n            // 找差异\n            Map<Row, Integer> missing = new HashMap<>(expCounts);\n            actCounts.forEach((k, v) -> missing.merge(k, -v, (a, b) -> a - b));\n            missing.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() == 0);\n            Map<Row, Integer> extra = new HashMap<>(actCounts);\n            expCounts.forEach((k, v) -> extra.merge(k, -v, (a, b) -> a - b));\n            extra.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() == 0);\n            int shown = 0;\n            for (var e : missing.entrySet()) {\n                if (shown++ >= 10) { sb.append(\"  ...（更多缺失省略）\\n\"); break; }\n                sb.append(\"  缺失 x\").append(e.getValue()).append(\" : \").append(e.getKey()).append('\\n');\n            }\n            shown = 0;\n            for (var e : extra.entrySet()) {\n                if (shown++ >= 10) { sb.append(\"  ...（更多多余省略）\\n\"); break; }\n                sb.append(\"  多余 x\").append(e.getValue()).append(\" : \").append(e.getKey()).append('\\n');\n            }\n            throw new AssertionError(sb.toString());\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 端到端：同一请求分别跑引擎与参考实现并比较。 */\n    public static QueryResult assertAgainstReference(QueryRequest req) {\n        List<Row> expected = runReference(req);\n        QueryResult actual = runEngine(req);\n        assertMultisetEquals(expected, actual.rows);\n        // 输出行数与参考一致\n        if (actual.rows.size() != expected.size()) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"行数不一致：\" + expected.size() + \" vs \" + actual.rows.size());\n        }\n        return actual;\n    }\n\n    /** 从行中抽取键（供多重集断言之外的附加检查）。 */\n    public static List<Key> keysOf(List<Row> rows, int[] idxs) {\n        List<Key> ks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) ks.add(Key.ofRow(r, idxs));\n        return ks;\n    }\n\n    public static List<Object> valuesAsJson(QueryResult r) {\n        List<Object> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row row : r.rows) {\n            List<Object> vals = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < row.width(); i++) vals.add(row.get(i).toJson());\n            out.add(vals);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_3e4993e6921f1d50ddf65852","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":571,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":84792,"output_tokens":1780,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_9pm8c76g33zlcqxkv5it88qg":{"content":"package cols.add(\"k\");\n        if (payloadWidth > 0) cols.add(\"payload\");\n        List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object key;\n            boolean isNull = rnd.nextInt(100) < nullPct;\n            if (isNull) {\n                key = null;\n            } else if (mixedTypes && rnd.nextInt(100) < 30) {\n                // 30% 概率用字符串形式的数字（与数值不相等，制造跨型不匹配）\n                key = \"s\" + rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            } else if (mixedTypes && rnd.nextInt(100) < 10) {\n                key = (double) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            } else {\n                key = (long) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            }\n            List<Object> vals = new ArrayList<>();\n            vals.add((long) i);\n            vals.add(key);\n            if (payloadWidth > 0) vals.add(name + \"-payload-\" + i + \"-\" + \"x\".repeat(payloadWidth));\n            rows.add(row(vals.toArray()));\n        }\n        return new Relation(name, cols, rows);\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 跑两种实现\n\n    public static QueryRequest request(Relation left, Relation right, JoinType type,\n                                       List<String> keys, long threshold,\n                                       int partitions, long quotaBytes) {\n        QueryRequest q = new QueryRequest();\n        q.joinType = type;\n        q.keyPairs = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String k : keys) q.keyPairs.add(new phj.core.JoinKeyPair(k, k));\n        q.left = left;\n        q.right = right;\n        q.memoryThresholdRows = threshold;\n        q.partitions = partitions;\n        q.diskQuotaBytes = quotaBytes;\n        q.spillDir = null;\n        q.validate();\n        return q;\n    }\n\n    public static QueryResult runEngine(QueryRequest req) {\n        return new HashJoinEngine(req).execute();\n    }\n\n    public static List<Row> runReference(QueryRequest req) {\n        int[][] idx = req.resolveKeyIndices(req.left, req.right);\n        return NestedLoopJoin.join(req.left, req.right, idx[0], idx[1], req.joinType);\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 多重集比对\n\n    /** 比较两个行集合作为多重集是否相同（顺序无关、重复次数敏感）。 */\n    public static void assertMultisetEquals(Collection<Row> expected, Collection<Row> actual) {\n        Map<Row, Integer> expCounts = new HashMap<>();\n        Map<Row, Integer> actCounts = new HashMap<>();\n        for (Row r : expected) expCounts.merge(r, 1, Integer::sum);\n        for (Row r : actual) actCounts.merge(r, 1, Integer::sum);\n        if (!expCounts.equals(actCounts)) {\n            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"多重集不匹配！\\n\");\n            sb.append(\"期望行数=\").append(expected.size()).append(\" 实际行数=\").append(actual.size()).append('\\n');\n            // 找差异\n            Map<Row, Integer> missing = new HashMap<>(expCounts);\n            actCounts.forEach((k, v) -> missing.merge(k, -v, (a, b) -> a - b));\n            missing.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() == 0);\n            Map<Row, Integer> extra = new HashMap<>(actCounts);\n            expCounts.forEach((k, v) -> extra.merge(k, -v, (a, b) -> a - b));\n            extra.entrySet().removeIf(e -> e.getValue() == 0);\n            int shown = 0;\n            for (var e : missing.entrySet()) {\n                if (shown++ >= 10) { sb.append(\"  ...（更多缺失省略）\\n\"); break; }\n                sb.append(\"  缺失 x\").append(e.getValue()).append(\" : \").append(e.getKey()).append('\\n');\n            }\n            shown = 0;\n            for (var e : extra.entrySet()) {\n                if (shown++ >= 10) { sb.append(\"  ...（更多多余省略）\\n\"); break; }\n                sb.append(\"  多余 x\").append(e.getValue()).append(\" : \").append(e.getKey()).append('\\n');\n            }\n            throw new AssertionError(sb.toString());\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** 端到端：同一请求分别跑引擎与参考实现并比较。 */\n    public static QueryResult assertAgainstReference(QueryRequest req) {\n        List<Row> expected = runReference(req);\n        QueryResult actual = runEngine(req);\n        assertMultisetEquals(expected, actual.rows);\n        // 输出行数与参考一致\n        if (actual.rows.size() != expected.size()) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"行数不一致：\" + expected.size() + \" vs \" + actual.rows.size());\n        }\n        return actual;\n    }\n\n    /** 从行中抽取键（供多重集断言之外的附加检查）。 */\n    public static List<Key> keysOf(List<Row> rows, int[] idxs) {\n        List<Key> ks = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row r : rows) ks.add(Key.ofRow(r, idxs));\n        return ks;\n    }\n\n    public static List<Object> valuesAsJson(QueryResult r) {\n        List<Object> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Row row : r.rows) {\n            List<Object> vals = new ArrayList<>();\n            for (int i = 0; i < row.width(); i++) vals.add(row.get(i).toJson());\n            out.add(vals);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2e541fdc-9b1e-4479-b2cb-24cd1cefffff","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

t0) / 1e6;\n                System.out.printf(\"  PASS %-48s %8.2f ms%n\", m.getName(), ms);\n            } catch (java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException ite) {\n                testsFailed++;\n                Throwable cause = ite.getCause() != null ? ite.getCause() : ite;\n                String msg = testClass.getSimpleName() + \".\" + m.getName()\n                        + \" -> \" + cause.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + cause.getMessage();\n                failures.add(msg);\n                System.out.println(\"  FAIL \" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + cause);\n                cause.printStackTrace(System.out);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                testsFailed++;\n                failures.add(testClass.getSimpleName() + \".\" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + e);\n                System.out.println(\"  FAIL \" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + e);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public int summary() {\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"----------------------------------------\");\n        System.out.println(\"总计 \" + testsRun + \"，失败 \" + testsFailed);\n        if (testsFailed > 0) {\n            System.out.println(\"失败用例：\");\n            for (String f : failures) System.out.println(\"  - \" + f);\n            return 1;\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"全部通过 ✅\");\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 断言\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond, String msg) {\n        if (!cond) throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond) {\n        assertTrue(cond, \"期望 true，实际 false\");\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) {\n        if (expected == null ? actual != null : !expected.equals(actual)) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(long expected, long actual) {\n        if (expected != actual) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void fail(String msg) {\n        throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":86,"oldLines":6,"newStart":86,"newLines":12,"lines":["         }","     }"," ","+    public static void assertEquals(double expected, double actual, double delta) {","+        if (Math.abs(expected - actual) > delta) {","+            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");","+        }","+    }","+","     public static void fail(String msg) {","         throw new AssertionError(msg);","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e5182d22-1730-4723-85de-41b2585bddcd","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

{"parentUuid":"0bfdcd22-35d2-43b3-b495-b47387eb9ad7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_bycttsqj8g7mzqlmmfyhpb3z","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a/test/phj/join/EngineSemanticsTest.java","content":"package phj.join;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class EngineSemanticsTest {\n\n    private static Relation L(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static Relation R(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static QueryResult run(Relation l, Relation r, JoinType t, long threshold, int parts) {\n        return TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(\n                TestUtil.request(l, r, t, List.of(\"k\"), threshold, parts, -1));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- Value 语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void valueNullNeverEqualsNull() {\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.NULL.equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofString(\"a\").equals(Value.ofString(\"a\")));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofString(\"1\").equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofBool(true).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericCrossTypeEquality() {\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.ofDouble(1.0)));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(1).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(1.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(2.0).equals(Value.ofLong(2)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(1.5).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        // 相等对象必须哈希相同（哈希表契约）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofDouble(2.0).hashCode(), Value.ofLong(2).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)) == false\n                || Value.ofLong(0).hashCode() != Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode() ? false : true);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(0).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void multiColumnKeySemantics() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{2, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, \"y\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"a\", \"b\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 仅 (1,\"x\")=(1,\"x\") 一条；NULL 行不匹配\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"x\", 1, \"x\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 基本连接语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerBasicInMemory() {\n        QueryResult qr = run(\n                L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20}, new Object[]{3, null, 30}),\n                R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"c\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, null, \"Z\"}),\n                JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"a\", 10, 10, \"a\", \"X\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftBasicInMemory() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20},\n                new Object[]{3, null, 30}, new Object[]{4, \"z\", 40});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        // a 匹配一条；b / z / null 均补 NULL 行\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysCartesianProduct() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, qr.rows.size()); // 3 x 2\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6L, qr.stats.get(\"outputRows\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysSpillAndFallback() {\n        // 阈值=1 + 单一热点键 -> BNL 回退，必须仍是笛卡尔积\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3},\n                new Object[]{4, \"a\", 4});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, \"a\", \"Z\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(12, qr.rows.size()); // 4 x 3\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"boundedFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应至少发生一次有界回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void nullKeySemanticsBothSides() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        // INNER：NULL=NULL 不匹配，只留 a\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, inner.rows.size());\n        // LEFT：两条左 NULL 行各补 NULL，a 匹配\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(3, left.rows.size());\n        long nullPad = left.rows.stream().filter(x -> x.get(3).isNull()).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2L, nullPad);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void emptyTables() {\n        Relation nonEmpty = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1});\n        Relation emptyL = new Relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), List.of());\n        Relation emptyR = new Relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), List.of());\n\n        // INNER 任一表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        // LEFT 右表空 -> 左表全部补 NULL\n        QueryResult left = run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(left.rows.get(0).get(3).isNull());\n        // LEFT 左表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4).rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void allNullKeys() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"});\n        // 需要落盘的体量，但全是 NULL 键：不产生任何分区写入\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, inner.rows.size());\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, left.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericKeysLongAndDouble() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{1, 1L}, new Object[]{2, 2L}, new Object[]{3, 3L});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{10, 1.0}, new Object[]{11, 2.0}, new Object[]{12, 4.0});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size()); // 1=1.0, 2=2.0\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerPicksSmallerSideAsBuild() {\n        // 左大右小：INNER 应选右表为建表侧；结果多重集与参考一致即语义正确\n        Relation l = L();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> lrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{i, i % 7, i});\n        l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, 0L, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, 6L, \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 2, 4, -1);\n        // 100 行里 k=0 或 k=6 各 ~14-15 个\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.rows.size() >= 28, \"应当有 28+ 匹配，实际 \" + qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", planBuildSide(qr));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftAlwaysBuildsRight() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 2});\n        Relation r = R();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> rrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{100 + i, i % 5L, \"w\" + i});\n        r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 2, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", planBuildSide(qr));\n        // 两个左行都至少出现一次（匹配或补 NULL）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    private static String planBuildSide(QueryResult qr) {\n        Object bs = phj.join;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class EngineSemanticsTest {\n\n    private static Relation L(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static Relation R(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static QueryResult run(Relation l, Relation r, JoinType t, long threshold, int parts) {\n        return TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(\n                TestUtil.request(l, r, t, List.of(\"k\"), threshold, parts, -1));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- Value 语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void valueNullNeverEqualsNull() {\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.NULL.equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofString(\"a\").equals(Value.ofString(\"a\")));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofString(\"1\").equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofBool(true).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericCrossTypeEquality() {\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.ofDouble(1.0)));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(1).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(1.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(2.0).equals(Value.ofLong(2)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(1.5).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        // 相等对象必须哈希相同（哈希表契约）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofDouble(2.0).hashCode(), Value.ofLong(2).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)) == false\n                || Value.ofLong(0).hashCode() != Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode() ? false : true);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(0).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void multiColumnKeySemantics() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{2, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, \"y\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"a\", \"b\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 仅 (1,\"x\")=(1,\"x\") 一条；NULL 行不匹配\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"x\", 1, \"x\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 基本连接语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerBasicInMemory() {\n        QueryResult qr = run(\n                L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20}, new Object[]{3, null, 30}),\n                R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"c\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, null, \"Z\"}),\n                JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"a\", 10, 10, \"a\", \"X\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftBasicInMemory() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20},\n                new Object[]{3, null, 30}, new Object[]{4, \"z\", 40});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        // a 匹配一条；b / z / null 均补 NULL 行\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysCartesianProduct() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, qr.rows.size()); // 3 x 2\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6L, qr.stats.get(\"outputRows\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysSpillAndFallback() {\n        // 阈值=1 + 单一热点键 -> BNL 回退，必须仍是笛卡尔积\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3},\n                new Object[]{4, \"a\", 4});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, \"a\", \"Z\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(12, qr.rows.size()); // 4 x 3\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"boundedFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应至少发生一次有界回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void nullKeySemanticsBothSides() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        // INNER：NULL=NULL 不匹配，只留 a\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, inner.rows.size());\n        // LEFT：两条左 NULL 行各补 NULL，a 匹配\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(3, left.rows.size());\n        long nullPad = left.rows.stream().filter(x -> x.get(3).isNull()).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2L, nullPad);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void emptyTables() {\n        Relation nonEmpty = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1});\n        Relation emptyL = new Relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), List.of());\n        Relation emptyR = new Relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), List.of());\n\n        // INNER 任一表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        // LEFT 右表空 -> 左表全部补 NULL\n        QueryResult left = run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(left.rows.get(0).get(3).isNull());\n        // LEFT 左表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4).rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void allNullKeys() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"});\n        // 需要落盘的体量，但全是 NULL 键：不产生任何分区写入\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, inner.rows.size());\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, left.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericKeysLongAndDouble() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{1, 1L}, new Object[]{2, 2L}, new Object[]{3, 3L});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{10, 1.0}, new Object[]{11, 2.0}, new Object[]{12, 4.0});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size()); // 1=1.0, 2=2.0\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerPicksSmallerSideAsBuild() {\n        // 左大右小：INNER 应选右表为建表侧；结果多重集与参考一致即语义正确\n        Relation l = L();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> lrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{i, i % 7, i});\n        l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, 0L, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, 6L, \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 2, 4, -1);\n        // 100 行里 k=0 或 k=6 各 ~14-15 个\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.rows.size() >= 28, \"应当有 28+ 匹配，实际 \" + qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", planBuildSide(qr));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftAlwaysBuildsRight() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 2});\n        Relation r = R();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> rrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{100 + i, i % 5L, \"w\" + i});\n        r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 2, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", Object[]{1, \"nope\", 1});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"b\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 2, -1);\n        Row out = qr.rows.get(0);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, out.width());\n        for (int i = 3; i < 6; i++) TestRunner.assertTrue(out.get(i).isNull(), \"右列补位应为 NULL\");\n java.util.List;\n\npublic class EngineSemanticsTest {\n\n    private static Relation L(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static Relation R(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static QueryResult run(Relation l, Relation r, JoinType t, long threshold, int parts) {\n        return TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(\n                TestUtil.request(l, r, t, List.of(\"k\"), threshold, parts, -1));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- Value 语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void valueNullNeverEqualsNull() {\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.NULL.equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofString(\"a\").equals(Value.ofString(\"a\")));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofString(\"1\").equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofBool(true).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericCrossTypeEquality() {\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.ofDouble(1.0)));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(1).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(1.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(2.0).equals(Value.ofLong(2)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(1.5).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        // 相等对象必须哈希相同（哈希表契约）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofDouble(2.0).hashCode(), Value.ofLong(2).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)) == false\n                || Value.ofLong(0).hashCode() != Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode() ? false : true);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(0).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void multiColumnKeySemantics() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{2, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, \"y\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"a\", \"b\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 仅 (1,\"x\")=(1,\"x\") 一条；NULL 行不匹配\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"x\", 1, \"x\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 基本连接语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerBasicInMemory() {\n        QueryResult qr = run(\n                L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20}, new Object[]{3, null, 30}),\n                R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"c\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, null, \"Z\"}),\n                JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"a\", 10, 10, \"a\", \"X\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftBasicInMemory() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20},\n                new Object[]{3, null, 30}, new Object[]{4, \"z\", 40});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        // a 匹配一条；b / z / null 均补 NULL 行\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysCartesianProduct() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, qr.rows.size()); // 3 x 2\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6L, qr.stats.get(\"outputRows\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysSpillAndFallback() {\n        // 阈值=1 + 单一热点键 -> BNL 回退，必须仍是笛卡尔积\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3},\n                new Object[]{4, \"a\", 4});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, \"a\", \"Z\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(12, qr.rows.size()); // 4 x 3\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"boundedFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应至少发生一次有界回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void nullKeySemanticsBothSides() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        // INNER：NULL=NULL 不匹配，只留 a\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, inner.rows.size());\n        // LEFT：两条左 NULL 行各补 NULL，a 匹配\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(3, left.rows.size());\n        long nullPad = Object[]{1, \"a\", 1});\n        Relation emptyL = new Relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), List.of());\n        Relation emptyR = new Relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), List.of());\n\n        // INNER 任一表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        // LEFT 右表空 -> 左表全部补 NULL\n        QueryResult left = run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(left.rows.get(0).get(3).isNull());\n        // LEFT 左表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4).rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void allNullKeys() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"});\n        // 需要落盘的体量，但全是 NULL 键：不产生任何分区写入\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, inner.rows.size());\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, left.rows.size());\n new Object[]{11, 2.0}, new Object[]{12, 4.0});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size()); // 1=1.0, 2=2.0\n    }\n\n    @Test\n t0) / 1e6;\n                System.out.printf(\"  PASS %-48s %8.2f ms%n\", m.getName(), ms);\n            } catch (java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException ite) {\n                testsFailed++;\n                Throwable cause = ite.getCause() != null ? ite.getCause() : ite;\n                String msg = testClass.getSimpleName() + \".\" + m.getName()\n                        + \" -> \" + cause.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + cause.getMessage();\n                failures.add(msg);\n                System.out.println(\"  FAIL \" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + cause);\n                cause.printStackTrace(System.out);\n            } catch (Exception e) {\n                testsFailed++;\n                failures.add(testClass.getSimpleName() + \".\" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + e);\n                System.out.println(\"  FAIL \" + m.getName() + \" -> \" + e);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    public int summary() {\n        System.out.println();\n        System.out.println(\"----------------------------------------\");\n        System.out.println(\"总计 \" + testsRun + \"，失败 \" + testsFailed);\n        if (testsFailed > 0) {\n            System.out.println(\"失败用例：\");\n            for (String f : failures) System.out.println(\"  - \" + f);\n            return 1;\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"全部通过 ✅\");\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    // --------------------------------------------------------------- 断言\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond, String msg) {\n        if (!cond) throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n\n    public static void assertTrue(boolean cond) {\n        assertTrue(cond, \"期望 true，实际 false\");\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(Object expected, Object actual) {\n        if (expected == null ? actual != null : !expected.equals(actual)) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(long expected, long actual) {\n        if (expected != actual) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void assertEquals(double expected, double actual, double delta) {\n        if (Math.abs(expected - actual) > delta) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"期望 <\" + expected + \"> 实际 <\" + actual + \">\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    public static void fail(String msg) {\n        throw new AssertionError(msg);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":70,"oldLines":6,"newStart":70,"newLines":14,"lines":["         if (!cond) throw new AssertionError(msg);","     }"," ","+    public static void assertFalse(boolean cond) {","+        assertTrue(!cond, \"期望 false，实际 true\");","+    }","+","+    public static void assertFalse(boolean cond, String msg) {","+        assertTrue(!cond, msg);","+    }","+","     public static void assertTrue(boolean cond) {","         assertTrue(cond, \"期望 true，实际 false\");","     }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"12bde941-7ae8-46ee-8cac-0d46573493e1","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}
