phj.join;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class SpillMechanicsTest {\n\n    private static Relation mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 3);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillsWhenOverThreshold() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 60, 20, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 60, 20, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\") > 0, \"应当发生落盘\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\") >= 1, \"应有落盘波次\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void noSpillWhenFitsInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 5, 5, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 5, 5, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillFilesAreKeptWhenRequested() throws Exception {\n        Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"phj-keep-\");\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 40, 15, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 40, 15, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        req.spillDir = tmp;\n        req.keepSpillFiles = true;\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.spillDir != null, \"应返回保留目录\");\n        Path dir = Path.of(qr.spillDir);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(dir), \"保留目录应存在\");\n        long jsonl = Files.walk(dir).filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(\".jsonl\")).count();\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(jsonl > 0, \"应保留至少一个分区文件，实际 \" + jsonl);\n        // 抽样检查分区文件每行都是合法 JSON 数组\n        Path sample = Files.walk(dir).filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(\".jsonl\"))\n                .findFirst().orElseThrow();\n        List<String> lines = Files.readAllLines(sample);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(!lines.isEmpty(), \"分区文件不应为空\");\n        for (String line : lines) {\n            Object parsed = phj.json.Json.parse(line);\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(parsed instanceof List<?>, \"分区行应为 JSON 数组\");\n        }\n        // 清理\n        try (var walk = Files.walk(tmp)) {\n            walk.sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(p -> {\n                try { Files.deleteIfExists(p); } catch (Exception ignored) { }\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillFilesDeletedByDefault() throws Exception {\n        Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"phj-clean-\");\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 40, 15, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 40, 15, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        req.spillDir = tmp;\n        req.keepSpillFiles = false;\n        TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        long remaining = Files.walk(tmp).filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().startsWith(\"phj-spill-\")).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, remaining);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void recursiveRepartitionHandlesSkew() {\n        // 中等基数 + 阈值极小：初始分区后必有大分区触发递归或回退，结果仍须正确\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 300, 100, 0, 11);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 300, 100, 0, 22);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 3, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\") != null);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void singleHotKeyTriggersBoundedFallback() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 1, 0, 1);   // 全部 k=0\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 1, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(10000, qr.rows.size()); // 100 x 100\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"hotKeyFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应识别热点并回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void hotKeyWithLeftJoinMarksAllProbes() {\n        // 全热点 LEFT：所有探测行都会匹配，不应有错误的补 NULL 行\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 80, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 60, 1, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4800, qr.rows.size()); // 80 x 60，无补位\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void mixedHotAndColdKeysLeftJoin() {\n        // 热点键 + 冷门键 + 无匹配键，LEFT 下 BNL 位图标记必须正确\n        List<Object[]> lrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Object[]> rrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        int id = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"hot\", \"L\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"cold\" + (i % 3), \"L\"});\n        lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"never\", \"L\"});\n        int cid = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{cid++, \"hot\", \"R\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{cid++, \"cold\" + (i % 3), \"R\"});\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 5, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        long nullPad = qr.rows.stream().filter(x -> x.get(3).isNull()).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1L, nullPad, \"仅 'never' 键那一行补 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftJoinDiskMarkerUsedForLargeProbePartition() {\n        // 探测分区大（超阈值），走磁盘位图标记分支\n        List<Object[]> lrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Object[]> rrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{i, i % 30, \"L\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{1000 + i, i % 30, \"R\"});\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 计划树里应出现 disk marker 或 memory marker（两种实现都覆盖过时此断言放宽为存在 marker 字段）\n        final boolean[] hasMarker = {false};\n        walk(qr.planRoot.toMap(), hasMarker);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(hasMarker[0], \"LEFT 落盘路径应记录 marker 类型\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private void walk(java.util.Map<String, Object> node, boolean[] found) {\n        if (node.containsKey(\"marker\")) found[0] = true;\n        Object kids = node.get(\"children\");\n        if (kids instanceof List<?> list) {\n            for (Object o : list) walk((java.util.Map<String, Object>) o, found);\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void partitionCountConfigIsHonored() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 80, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 80, 40, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 13, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(13L, qr.planRoot.toMap().get(\"initialPartitions\"));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_25af763ae709ff5482f76825","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":423,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":91960,"output_tokens":2690,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_k70brv1o86suqvddi9yro4hu":{"content":"package public void spillsWhenOverThreshold() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 60, 20, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 60, 20, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 中等基数 + 阈值极小：初始分区后必有大分区触发递归或回退，结果仍须正确\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 300, 100, 0, 11);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 300, 100, 0, 22);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, {"parentUuid":"4af0c739-a5ee-48bd-9e9f-f603631e05b8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_xqlz6y0cntrq6nwobdaw1qyp","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a/test/phj/join/CorrectnessFuzzTest.java","content":"package phj.join;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 随机模糊测试（固定种子，可复现）。\n * 覆盖矩阵：INNER/LEFT × 内存/落盘/热点/倾斜 × 不同阈值/分区数/NULL 比例/列宽。\n * 每一例都用嵌套循环参考实现做多重集比对。\n */\npublic class CorrectnessFuzzTest {\n\n    private int casesExecuted;\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzMatrixAgainstNestedLoop() {\n        long seed0 = 20260923L;\n        JoinType[] types = {JoinType.INNER, JoinType.LEFT};\n        int[] leftSizes = {0, 1, 3, 25, 120};\n        int[] rightSizes = {0, 1, 4, 30, 100};\n        int[] distinctKeys = {1, 2, 7, 500};\n        int[] nullPcts = {0, 15, 60, 100};\n        long[] thresholds = {1, 3, 8};\n        int[] partitionsCfg = {0, 2, 5};\n        int caseNo = 0;\n\n        // 为控制运行时间，取确定性抽样而非全笛卡尔积\n        java.util.Random sampler = new java.util.Random(seed0);\n        int totalCases = 260;\n        for (int c = 0; c < totalCases; c++) {\n            JoinType type = types[sampler.nextInt(types.length)];\n            int ln = leftSizes[sampler.nextInt(leftSizes.length)];\n            int rn = rightSizes[sampler.nextInt(rightSizes.length)];\n            int dk = distinctKeys[sampler.nextInt(distinctKeys.length)];\n            int np = nullPcts[sampler.nextInt(nullPcts.length)];\n            long th = thresholds[sampler.nextInt(thresholds.length)];\n            int parts = partitionsCfg[sampler.nextInt(partitionsCfg.length)];\n            boolean mixed = sampler.nextBoolean();\n            int payload = sampler.nextInt(4) == 0 ? 0 : sampler.nextInt(6); // 部分用例无负载列\n\n            long seed = seed0 + c * 1009L;\n            Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", ln, dk, np, new java.util.Random(seed), mixed, payload);\n            Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", rn, dk, np, new java.util.Random(seed + 1), mixed, payload);\n\n            QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), th, parts, -1);\n            QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n            caseNo++;\n\n            // 额外不变量：INNER 输出行右列宽与左列宽都正确；LEFT 行数 >= 左表行数\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.rows.size() >= ln,\n                        \"LEFT 输出行数不应少于左表行数：case=\" + caseNo);\n            }\n            for (var row : qr.rows) {\n                TestRunner.assertEquals(l.width() + r.width(), row.width());\n            }\n        }\n        casesExecuted = caseNo;\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 完成 \" + caseNo + \" 个随机用例（含空表/全NULL/全热点）\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzLargeHotKeyWithNulls() {\n        // 重点场景：大单键热点 + NULL 混入，阈值=1 逼出热点回退，两表体量较大\n        int totalCases = 12;\n        for (int c = 0; c < totalCases; c++) {\n            long seed = 7700 + c;\n            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);\n            int ln = 200 + rnd.nextInt(200);\n            int rn = 150 + rnd.nextInt(150);\n            int nullPct = c % 4 == 0 ? 30 : c % 4;\n            for (JoinType type : JoinType.values()) {\n                Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", ln, 1, nullPct,\n                        new java.util.Random(seed), false, 4);\n                Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", rn, 1, nullPct,\n                        new java.util.Random(seed + 1), false, 4);\n                QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, -1);\n                QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"hotKeyFallbacks\") >= 1,\n                        \"全热点键应触发回退，case=\" + c);\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 完成 \" + totalCases + \" x2 个全热点用例\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzManyThresholdsPartitions() {\n        // 固定数据，扫一遍阈值与分区数组合，结果多重集必须始终一致\n        Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", 220, 33, 12, new java.util.Random(99), true, 2);\n        Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", 180, 33, 12, new java.util.Random(100), true, 2);\n        int n = 0;\n        for (JoinType type : JoinType.values()) {\n            for (long th : new long[]{1, 2, 5, 11, 500}) {\n                for (int parts : new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 37}) {\n                    QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), th, parts, -1);\n                    TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                    n++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 阈值x分区矩阵完成 \" + n + \" 例\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzMultiColumnKeys() {\n        // 多列键（2 列），含 NULL 与跨型\n        int n = 0;\n        for (JoinType type : JoinType.values()) {\n            for (int t = 0; t < 20; t++) {\n                java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(5000 + t);\n                Relation l = twoColRel(\"L\", 60, 8, 20, rnd);\n                Relation r = twoColRel(\"R\", 50, 8, 20, new java.util.Random(6000 + t));\n                QueryRequest req = new QueryRequest();\n                req.joinType = type;\n                req.keyPairs = List.of(\n                        new phj.core.JoinKeyPair(\"k1\", \"k1\"),\n                        new phj.core.JoinKeyPair(\"k2\", \"k2\"));\n                req.left = l;\n                req.right = r;\n                req.memoryThresholdRows = 1 + (t % 5);\n                req.partitions = 2 + (t % 4);\n                req.diskQuotaBytes = -1;\n                req.validate();\n                TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                n++;\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 多列键完成 \" + n + \" 例\");\n    }\n\n    private Relation twoColRel(String name, int rows, int dk1, int nullPct, java.util.Random rnd) {\n        List<String> cols = List.of(\"id\", \"k1\", \"k2\", \"p\");\n        List<Object[]> data = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {\n            Object k1 = rnd.nextInt(100) < nullPct ? null : (long) rnd.nextInt(dk1);\n            Object k2;\n            int roll = rnd.nextInt(100);\n            if (roll < nullPct) k2 = null;\n            else if (roll < nullPct + 15) k2 = \"s\" + rnd.nextInt(dk1); // 字符串类\n            else k2 = (long) rnd.nextInt(dk1);\n            data.add(new Object[]{(long) i, k1, k2, name + i});\n        }\n        return TestUtil.relation(name, cols, data.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_ac733f41db41259d1450784e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":409,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":95032,"output_tokens":2175,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_xqlz6y0cntrq6nwobdaw1qyp":{"content":"package {1, 3, 8};\n        int[] partitionsCfg = {0, 2, 5};\n        int caseNo = 0;\n\n        // 为控制运行时间，取确定性抽样而非全笛卡尔积\n        java.util.Random sampler = new java.util.Random(seed0);\n        int totalCases = 260;\n        for (int c = 0; c < totalCases; c++) {\n            JoinType type = types[sampler.nextInt(types.length)];\n            int ln = leftSizes[sampler.nextInt(leftSizes.length)];\n            int rn = rightSizes[sampler.nextInt(rightSizes.length)];\n            int dk = distinctKeys[sampler.nextInt(distinctKeys.length)];\n            int np = nullPcts[sampler.nextInt(nullPcts.length)];\n            long th = thresholds[sampler.nextInt(thresholds.length)];\n            int parts = partitionsCfg[sampler.nextInt(partitionsCfg.length)];\n            boolean mixed = sampler.nextBoolean();\n            int payload = sampler.nextInt(4) == 0 ? 0 : sampler.nextInt(6); // 部分用例无负载列\n\n            long seed = seed0 + c * 1009L;\n            Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", ln, dk, np, new java.util.Random(seed), mixed, payload);\n            Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", rn, dk, np, new java.util.Random(seed + 1), mixed, payload);\n\n            QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), th, parts, -1);\n            QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n            caseNo++;\n\n            // 额外不变量：INNER 输出行右列宽与左列宽都正确；LEFT 行数 >= 左表行数\n            if (type == JoinType.LEFT) {\n                TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.rows.size() >= ln,\n                        \"LEFT 输出行数不应少于左表行数：case=\" + caseNo);\n            }\n            for (var row : qr.rows) {\n                TestRunner.assertEquals(l.width() + r.width(), row.width());\n            }\n        }\n        casesExecuted = caseNo;\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 完成 \" + caseNo + \" 个随机用例（含空表/全NULL/全热点）\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzLargeHotKeyWithNulls() {\n        // 重点场景：大单键热点 + NULL 混入，阈值=1 逼出热点回退，两表体量较大\n        int totalCases = 12;\n        for (int c = 0; c < totalCases; c++) {\n            long seed = 7700 + c;\n            java.util.Random rnd = new java.util.Random(seed);\n            int ln = 200 + rnd.nextInt(200);\n            int rn = 150 + rnd.nextInt(150);\n            int nullPct = c % 4 == 0 ? 30 : c % 4;\n            for (JoinType type : JoinType.values()) {\n                Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", ln, 1, nullPct,\n                        new java.util.Random(seed), false, 4);\n                Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", rn, 1, nullPct,\n                        new java.util.Random(seed + 1), false, 4);\n                QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, -1);\n                QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"hotKeyFallbacks\") >= 1,\n                        \"全热点键应触发回退，case=\" + c);\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 完成 \" + totalCases + \" x2 个全热点用例\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzManyThresholdsPartitions() {\n        // 固定数据，扫一遍阈值与分区数组合，结果多重集必须始终一致\n        Relation l = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"L\", 220, 33, 12, new java.util.Random(99), true, 2);\n        Relation r = TestUtil.randomRelation(\"R\", 180, 33, 12, new java.util.Random(100), true, 2);\n        int n = 0;\n        for (JoinType type : JoinType.values()) {\n            for (long th : new long[]{1, 2, 5, 11, 500}) {\n                for (int parts : new int[]{0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 37}) {\n                    QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, type, List.of(\"k\"), th, parts, -1);\n                    TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                    n++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 阈值x分区矩阵完成 \" + n + \" 例\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fuzzMultiColumnKeys() {\n        // 多列键（2 列），含 NULL 与跨型\n        int n = 0;\n        for (JoinType type              req.right = r;\n                req.memoryThresholdRows = 1 + (t % 5);\n                req.partitions = 2 + (t % 4);\n                req.diskQuotaBytes = -1;\n                req.validate();\n                TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n                n++;\n            }\n        }\n        System.out.println(\"    [fuzz] 多列键完成 \" + n + \" 例\");\n    }\n\n ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {\n            Object k1 = rnd.nextInt(100) < nullPct ? null : (long) rnd.nextInt(dk1);\n            Object k2;\n            int roll = }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"86d254bd-34c0-48f4-bf0a-29c4776da0a1","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d973b6984ee8840f26c778aa","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2636,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":95032,"output_tokens":1064,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pqxn1e4pac0ocewzr0qf4ufh":{"content":"package java.util.List;\n\npublic class DiskQuotaTest {\n\n    private static Relation mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 5);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 40, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, 0);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void tinyQuotaThrowsDuringInitialPartitioning() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 200, 80, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 200, 80, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 8, 16, 128);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, 4096);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInLeftMarker() {\n        // 全热点 LEFT：BNL 需要标记位图，额度给到回退阶段但不够标记文件\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 5000, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 5000, 1, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 4, 600_000);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, 0);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void generousQuotaSucceeds() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 300, 60, 10, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 300, 60, 10, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, 50_000_000);\n        TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n    }\n\n    private void {\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.usedBytes() <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fca411d4-7700-4465-be40-8d8d9d8b457c","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

phj.cli;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.json.Json;\n\nimport java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 通过子进程调用 CLI，验证标准输入/文件入口、退出码与响应结构。 */\npublic class CliEndToEndTest {\n\n    private static String classpath() {\n        return System.getProperty(\"java.class.path\");\n    }\n\n    private record Result(int exit, String stdout, String stderr) {}\n\n    private static Result runCli(String inputFile, String stdin) throws Exception {\n        Path cpFile = Files.createTempFile(\"phj-stdin-\", \".json\");\n        try {\n            List<String> cmd = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n            cmd.add(java.nio.file.Paths.get(System.getProperty(\"java.home\"), \"bin\", \"java\").toString());\n            cmd.add(\"-cp\");\n            cmd.add(classpath());\n            cmd.add(\"phj.Main\");\n            if (inputFile != null) cmd.add(inputFile);\n            ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);\n            Process p = pb.start();\n            if (stdin != null) {\n                p.getOutputStream().write(stdin.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));\n                p.getOutputStream().close();\n            }\n            String out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            String err = new String(p.getErrorStream().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            int code = p.waitFor();\n            return new Result(code, out, err);\n        } finally {\n            Files.deleteIfExists(cpFile);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static String sampleRequest(String joinType, long threshold, long quota) {\n        return \"\"\"\n            {\n              \"joinType\": \"%s\",\n              \"keys\": [\"k\"],\n              \"left\":  {\"name\":\"L\",\"columns\":[\"id\",\"k\"],\"rows\":[[1,\"a\"],[2,\"b\"],[3,null],[4,\"a\"]]},\n              \"right\": {\"name\":\"R\",\"columns\":[\"cid\",\"k\"],\"rows\":[[10,\"a\"],[11,\"a\"],[12,\"c\"]]},\n              \"options\": {\"memoryThresholdRows\": %d, \"partitions\": 3, \"diskQuotaBytes\": %d}\n            }\n            \"\"\".formatted(joinType, threshold, quota);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void stdinInputExitZero() throws Exception {\n        Result r = runCli(null, sampleRequest(\"INNER\", 2, -1));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, r.exit());\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // a:2x2=4\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4L, ((Number) result.get(\"rowCount\")).longValue());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void fileInputLeftJoin() throws Exception {\n        Path f = Files.createTempFile(\"phj-req-\", \".json\");\n        Files.writeString(f, sampleRequest(\"LEFT\", 1, -1));\n        Result r = runCli(f.toString(), null);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, r.exit());\n        Map<?, ?> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        Map<?, ?> result = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"result\");\n        // a 4 条 + b 补 NULL + null 补 NULL = 6\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6L, ((Number) result.get(\"rowCount\")).longValue());\n        Files.deleteIfExists(f);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void invalidJsonExit2() throws Exception {\n        Result r = runCli(null, \"{ not json\");\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, r.exit());\n        Map<?, ?> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Boolean.FALSE, resp.get(\"ok\"));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", resp.get(\"errorType\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void missingColumnExit2() throws Exception {\n        String bad = sampleRequest(\"INNER\", 2, -1).replace(\"\\\"k\\\"\", \"\\\"nope\\\"\");\n        Result r = runCli(null, bad);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, r.exit());\n        Map<?, ?> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"INVALID_REQUEST\", resp.get(\"errorType\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExceededExit3() throws Exception {\n        Result r = runCli(null, sampleRequest(\"INNER\", 1, 0));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(3, r.exit());\n        Map<?, ?> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"DISK_QUOTA_EXCEEDED\", resp.get(\"errorType\"));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, ((Number) resp.get(\"diskQuotaBytes\")).longValue());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void planIsExportedByDefault() throws Exception {\n        Result r = runCli(null, sampleRequest(\"INNER\", 2, -1));\n        Map<?, ?> resp = Json.asObj(Json.parse(r.stdout()), \"resp\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(resp.containsKey(\"executionPlan\"), \"默认应导出执行计划\");\n        Map<?, ?> plan = (Map<?, ?>) resp.get(\"executionPlan\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(plan.containsKey(\"stats\"));\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(plan.containsKey(\"plan\"));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e681aff6efa1f41aaf1ed0b2","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1708,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":97080,"output_tokens":1410,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_52gi0mydk3v0j8ad89fu1gp8":{"content":"package TestUtil.request(l, r, t, List.of(\"k\"), threshold, parts, quota));\n    }","originalFile":"package phj.join;\n\nimport phj.Test;\nimport phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.Key;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\nimport phj.core.Row;\nimport phj.core.Value;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class EngineSemanticsTest {\n\n    private static Relation L(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static Relation R(Object[]... rows) {\n        return TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rows);\n    }\n\n    private static QueryResult run(Relation l, Relation r, JoinType t, long threshold, int parts) {\n        return TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(\n                TestUtil.request(l, r, t, List.of(\"k\"), threshold, parts, -1));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- Value 语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void valueNullNeverEqualsNull() {\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.NULL.equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.NULL));\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofString(\"a\").equals(Value.ofString(\"a\")));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofString(\"1\").equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofBool(true).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericCrossTypeEquality() {\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofLong(1).equals(Value.ofDouble(1.0)));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(1).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(1.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(2.0).equals(Value.ofLong(2)));\n        TestRunner.assertFalse(Value.ofDouble(1.5).equals(Value.ofLong(1)));\n        // 相等对象必须哈希相同（哈希表契约）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofDouble(2.0).hashCode(), Value.ofLong(2).hashCode());\n        // +0.0 / -0.0 在连接语义里相等，且与 long 0 哈希一致\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Value.ofDouble(0.0).equals(Value.ofDouble(-0.0)));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(0).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(-0.0).hashCode());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(Value.ofLong(0).hashCode(), Value.ofDouble(0.0).hashCode());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void multiColumnKeySemantics() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{2, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"a\", \"b\"),\n                new Object[]{1, \"x\"}, new Object[]{1, \"y\"}, new Object[]{1, null});\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"a\", \"b\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 仅 (1,\"x\")=(1,\"x\") 一条；NULL 行不匹配\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"x\", 1, \"x\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------- 基本连接语义\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerBasicInMemory() {\n        QueryResult qr = run(\n                L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20}, new Object[]{3, null, 30}),\n                R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"c\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, null, \"Z\"}),\n                JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(TestUtil.row(1, \"a\", 10, 10, \"a\", \"X\"), qr.rows.get(0));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftBasicInMemory() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 10}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 20},\n                new Object[]{3, null, 30}, new Object[]{4, \"z\", 40});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        // a 匹配一条；b / z / null 均补 NULL 行\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysCartesianProduct() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, qr.rows.size()); // 3 x 2\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6L, qr.stats.get(\"outputRows\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void duplicateKeysSpillAndFallback() {\n        // 阈值=1 + 单一热点键 -> BNL 回退，必须仍是笛卡尔积\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"a\", 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3},\n                new Object[]{4, \"a\", 4});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"}, new Object[]{12, \"a\", \"Z\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(12, qr.rows.size()); // 4 x 3\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"boundedFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应至少发生一次有界回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void nullKeySemanticsBothSides() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2}, new Object[]{3, \"a\", 3});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"a\", \"Y\"});\n        // INNER：NULL=NULL 不匹配，只留 a\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, inner.rows.size());\n        // LEFT：两条左 NULL 行各补 NULL，a 匹配\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 100, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(3, left.rows.size());\n        long nullPad = left.rows.stream().filter(x -> x.get(3).isNull()).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2L, nullPad);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void emptyTables() {\n        Relation nonEmpty = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1});\n        Relation emptyL = new Relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), List.of());\n        Relation emptyR = new Relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), List.of());\n\n        // INNER 任一表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, emptyR, JoinType.INNER, 4, 4).rows.size());\n        // LEFT 右表空 -> 左表全部补 NULL\n        QueryResult left = run(nonEmpty, emptyR, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(left.rows.get(0).get(3).isNull());\n        // LEFT 左表空 -> 空\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, run(emptyL, nonEmpty, JoinType.LEFT, 4, 4).rows.size());\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void allNullKeys() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, null, 1}, new Object[]{2, null, 2});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, null, \"X\"});\n        // 需要落盘的体量，但全是 NULL 键：不产生任何分区写入\n        QueryResult inner = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0, inner.rows.size());\n        QueryResult left = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, left.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, left.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void numericKeysLongAndDouble() {\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{1, 1L}, new Object[]{2, 2L}, new Object[]{3, 3L});\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\"),\n                new Object[]{10, 1.0}, new Object[]{11, 2.0}, new Object[]{12, 4.0});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 1, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size()); // 1=1.0, 2=2.0\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void innerPicksSmallerSideAsBuild() {\n        // 左大右小：INNER 应选右表为建表侧；结果多重集与参考一致即语义正确\n        Relation l = L();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> lrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{i, i % 7, i});\n        l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, 0L, \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, 6L, \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.INNER, 2, 4, -1);\n        // 100 行里 k=0 或 k=6 各 ~14-15 个\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.rows.size() >= 28, \"应当有 28+ 匹配，实际 \" + qr.rows.size());\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", planBuildSide(qr));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftAlwaysBuildsRight() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"a\", 1}, new Object[]{2, \"b\", 2});\n        Relation r = R();\n        java.util.List<Object[]> rrows = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{100 + i, i % 5L, \"w\" + i});\n        r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 2, 4, -1);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(\"right\", planBuildSide(qr));\n        // 两个左行都至少出现一次（匹配或补 NULL）\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(2, qr.rows.size());\n    }\n\n    private static String planBuildSide(QueryResult qr) {\n        Object bs = qr.planRoot.toMap().get(\"buildSide\");\n        return bs == null ? null : bs.toString();\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void unmatchedLeftRowsHaveFullNullPadding() {\n        Relation l = L(new Object[]{1, \"nope\", 1});\n        Relation r = R(new Object[]{10, \"a\", \"X\"}, new Object[]{11, \"b\", \"Y\"});\n        QueryResult qr = run(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, 1, 2, -1);\n        Row out = qr.rows.get(0);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(6, out.width());\n        for (int i = 3; i < 6; i++) TestRunner.assertTrue(out.get(i).isNull(), \"右列补位应为 NULL\");\n Integer.parseInt(args[0]) : 8080;\n        HttpServer server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(port), 0);\n        server.createContext(\"/health\", HttpServerMain::health);\n        server.createContext(\"/query\", HttpServerMain::query);\n        server.setExecutor(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4));\n        server.start();\n        System.out.println(\"PHJ HTTP 服务已启动：http://localhost:\" + server.getAddress().getPort()\n                + \"  （POST /query，GET /health）\");\n    }\n\n    private static void health(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {\n        writeJson(ex, 200, \"{\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"service\\\":\\\"partitioned-hash-join\\\"}\");\n    }\n\n    private static void query(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {\n        try {\n            if (!\"POST\".equalsIgnoreCase(ex.getRequestMethod())) {\n                writeJson(ex, 405, \"{\\\"ok\\\":false,\\\"error\\\":\\\"仅支持 POST\\\"}\");\n                return;\n            }\n            String body = new String(ex.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            Map<String, Object> respMap;\n            int httpStatus;\n            try {\n                Map<String, Object> req = Json.asObj(Json.parse(body), \"请求\");\n                respMap = QueryRunner.run(req);\n                httpStatus = 200;\n            } catch (Throwable t) {\n                respMap = QueryRunner.errorResponse(t);\n                Object code = respMap.get(\"errorCode\");\n                httpStatus = code instanceof Number n ? n.intValue() : 500;\n            }\n            writeJson(ex, httpStatus, Json.write(respMap));\n        } catch (Throwable t) {\n            Map<String, Object> err = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            err.put(\"ok\", false);\n            err.put(\"error\", t.getMessage());\n            writeJson(ex, 500, Json.write(err));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void writeJson(HttpExchange ex, int status, String json) throws IOException {\n        byte[] payload = json.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        ex.getResponseHeaders().add(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json; charset=utf-8\");\n        ex.sendResponseHeaders(status, payload.length);\n        try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {\n            os.write(payload);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":39,"oldLines":11,"newStart":39,"newLines":11,"lines":["                 + \"  （POST /query，GET /health）\");","     }"," ","-    private static void health(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {","+    static void health(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {","         writeJson(ex, 200, \"{\\\"ok\\\":true,\\\"service\\\":\\\"partitioned-hash-join\\\"}\");","     }"," ","-    private static void query(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {","+    static void query(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {","         try {","             if (!\"POST\".equalsIgnoreCase(ex.getRequestMethod())) {","                 writeJson(ex, 405, \"{\\\"ok\\\":false,\\\"error\\\":\\\"仅支持 POST\\\"}\");"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b17e08cf-884b-4456-aaca-290fa1d16c0d","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

The first two failures have been diagnosed: Value.NULL's equality logic breaks null comparison operations, and Map.of has issues with null values. cmd.add(java.nio.file.Paths.get(System.getProperty(\"java.home\"), \"bin\", \"java\").toString());\n            cmd.add(\"-cp\");\n            cmd.add(classpath());\n phj.TestRunner;\nimport phj.core.JoinType;\nimport phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\n\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class SpillMechanicsTest {\n\n    private static Relation mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 3);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillsWhenOverThreshold() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 60, 20, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 60, 20, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\") > 0, \"应当发生落盘\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\") >= 1, \"应有落盘波次\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void noSpillWhenFitsInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 5, 5, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 5, 5, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillFilesAreKeptWhenRequested() throws Exception {\n        Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"phj-keep-\");\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 40, 15, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 40, 15, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        req.spillDir = tmp;\n        req.keepSpillFiles = true;\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.spillDir != null, \"应返回保留目录\");\n        Path dir = Path.of(qr.spillDir);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(dir), \"保留目录应存在\");\n        long jsonl = Files.walk(dir).filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(\".jsonl\")).count();\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(jsonl > 0, \"应保留至少一个分区文件，实际 \" + jsonl);\n        // 抽样检查分区文件每行都是合法 JSON 数组\n        Path sample = Files.walk(dir).filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(\".jsonl\"))\n                .findFirst().orElseThrow();\n        List<String> lines = Files.readAllLines(sample);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(!lines.isEmpty(), \"分区文件不应为空\");\n        for (String line : lines) {\n            Object parsed = phj.json.Json.parse(line);\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(parsed instanceof List<?>, \"分区行应为 JSON 数组\");\n        }\n        // 清理\n        try (var walk = Files.walk(tmp)) {\n            walk.sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(p -> {\n                try { Files.deleteIfExists(p); } catch (Exception ignored) { }\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void spillFilesDeletedByDefault() throws Exception {\n        Path tmp = Files.createTempDirectory(\"phj-clean-\");\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 40, 15, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 40, 15, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        req.spillDir = tmp;\n        req.keepSpillFiles = false;\n        TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        long remaining = Files.walk(tmp).filter(p -> p.getFileName().toString().startsWith(\"phj-spill-\")).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, remaining);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void recursiveRepartitionHandlesSkew() {\n        // 中等基数 + 阈值极小：初始分区后必有大分区触发递归或回退，结果仍须正确\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 300, 100, 0, 11);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 300, 100, 0, 22);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 3, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.stats.get(\"spillWaves\") != null);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void singleHotKeyTriggersBoundedFallback() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 1, 0, 1);   // 全部 k=0\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 1, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(10000, qr.rows.size()); // 100 x 100\n        TestRunner.assertTrue((Long) qr.stats.get(\"hotKeyFallbacks\") >= 1, \"应识别热点并回退\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void hotKeyWithLeftJoinMarksAllProbes() {\n        // 全热点 LEFT：所有探测行都会匹配，不应有错误的补 NULL 行\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 80, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 60, 1, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(4800, qr.rows.size()); // 80 x 60，无补位\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void mixedHotAndColdKeysLeftJoin() {\n        // 热点键 + 冷门键 + 无匹配键，LEFT 下 BNL 位图标记必须正确\n        List<Object[]> lrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Object[]> rrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        int id = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"hot\", \"L\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"cold\" + (i % 3), \"L\"});\n        lrows.add(new Object[]{id++, \"never\", \"L\"});\n        int cid = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{cid++, \"hot\", \"R\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{cid++, \"cold\" + (i % 3), \"R\"});\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 5, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        long nullPad = qr.rows.stream().filter(x -> x.get(3).isNull()).count();\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(1L, nullPad, \"仅 'never' 键那一行补 NULL\");\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void leftJoinDiskMarkerUsedForLargeProbePartition() {\n        // 探测分区大（超阈值），走磁盘位图标记分支\n        List<Object[]> lrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        List<Object[]> rrows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) lrows.add(new Object[]{i, i % 30, \"L\"});\n        for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) rrows.add(new Object[]{1000 + i, i % 30, \"R\"});\n        Relation l = TestUtil.relation(\"L\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", \"v\"), lrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        Relation r = TestUtil.relation(\"R\", List.of(\"cid\", \"k\", \"w\"), rrows.toArray(Object[][]::new));\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        // 计划树里应出现 disk marker 或 memory marker（两种实现都覆盖过时此断言放宽为存在 marker 字段）\n        final boolean[] hasMarker = {false};\n        walk(qr.planRoot.toMap(), hasMarker);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(hasMarker[0], \"LEFT 落盘路径应记录 marker 类型\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private void walk(java.util.Map<String, Object> node, boolean[] found) {\n        if (node.containsKey(\"marker\")) found[0] = true;\n        Object kids = node.get(\"children\");\n        if (kids instanceof List<?> list) {\n            for (Object o : list) walk((java.util.Map<String, Object>) o, found);\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void partitionCountConfigIsHonored() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 80, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 80, 40, 0, 2);\n        var req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 13, -1);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(13L, qr.planRoot.toMap().get(\"initialPartitions\"));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":51,"oldLines":17,"newStart":51,"newLines":27,"lines":["         TestRunner.assertTrue(qr.spillDir != null, TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 5);\n    }\n\n    /** 无负载列的窄表（id, k），单字节行，用于精确估算磁盘额度。 */\n    private static Relation false, 0);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 40, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, 4096);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", 5000, 1, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 4, 260_000);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 8, 50_000_000);\n        TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n    }\n\n    private void expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInLeftMarker() {\n        // 全热点 LEFT：BNL 需要与探测行数等大的标记位图（n 字节）。\n        // 先不限额测出 BNL 进入时的 live 占用基线，再把额度设为\n        // “基线 + 标记位图的一半”，保证初始分区写得下而标记位图写不下。\n        int n = 3000;\n        Relation l = shortRel(\"L\", n, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", n, 1, 0, 2);\n\n        QueryRequest measure = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 4, -1);\n        QueryResult mr = new HashJoinEngine(measure).execute(row -> { });\n        // 初始分区峰值；标记位图需要 n 字节\n        long peak = (Long) mr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\");\n\n        // 给一个只够初始分区、不够再加 n 字节标记的额度\n        long quota = peak; // 初始文件处理完会释放，但峰值=初始写入量；标记位图在热点分区仍存活时申请\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 4,\n                Math.max(0, quota - 1));\n        // quota 取 peak-1 时初始分区就可能失败；无论初始还是标记阶段，都应是 DiskQuotaException\n        expectQuota(failReq);\n    }","new_string":"    @Test\n    public void     QueryResult mr = new HashJoinEngine(measure).execute(row -> { });\n        long peak = (Long) mr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(peak > 0, \"前置：应发生落盘\");\n\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, peak);\n        // 初始分区正好写满额度；n 字节标记位图再申请即耗尽\n        DiskQuotaException ex = expectQuota(failReq);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(ex.usedBytes() <= peak, \"已用字节不应超额度\");\n    }\n\n    private DiskQuotaException expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new HashJoinEngine(req).execute(row <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n            return expected;\n        }\n TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 0);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void tinyQuotaThrowsDuringInitialPartitioning() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 200, 80, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 200, 80, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 8, 16, 128);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, 两份初始文件同时存活，\n        // BNL 在其基础上再申请 n 字节的标记位图。\n        // 额度取初始峰值（足够写初始分区），标记位图必然把 live 推过额度。\n        int n = 3000;\n        Relation l = shortRel(\"L\", n, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", n, 1, 0, 2);\n\n        QueryRequest measure = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, -1);\n        QueryResult mr = new HashJoinEngine(measure).execute(row -> { });\n        long peak = (Long) mr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(peak > 0, \"前置：应发生落盘\");\n\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, }\n\n    private DiskQuotaException expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new HashJoinEngine(req).execute(row -> { });\n            TestRunner.fail(\"期望抛出 DiskQuotaException\");\n            return null;\n        } catch (DiskQuotaException expected) {\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.usedBytes() <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n            return expected;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class DiskQuotaTest {\n\n    private static Relation mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 5);\n    }\n\n    /** 无负载列的窄表（id, k），单字节行，用于精确估算磁盘额度。 */\n    private static Relation shortRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 0);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 40, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, 0);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void tinyQuotaThrowsDuringInitialPartitioning() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 200, 80, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 200, 80, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 8, 16, 128);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, 4096);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInLeftMarker() {\n        // 全热点、单分区 LEFT：进入热点分区时 build+probe 两份初始文件同时存活，\n        // BNL 在其基础上再申请 n 字节的标记位图。\n        // 额度取初始峰值（足够写初始分区），标记位图必然把 live 推过额度。\n        int n = 3000;\n        Relation l = shortRel(\"L\", n, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", n, 1, 0, 2);\n\n        QueryRequest measure = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, -1);\n        QueryResult mr = new HashJoinEngine(measure).execute(row -> { });\n        long peak = (Long) mr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(peak > 0, \"前置：应发生落盘\");\n\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, peak);\n        // 初始分区正好写满额度；n 字节标记位图再申请即耗尽\n        DiskQuotaException ex = expectQuota(failReq);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(ex.usedBytes() <= peak, \"已用字节不应超额度\");\n    }\n\n    private DiskQuotaException expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new HashJoinEngine(req).execute(row -> { });\n            TestRunner.fail(\"期望抛出 DiskQuotaException\");\n            return null;\n        } catch (DiskQuotaException expected) {\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.usedBytes() <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n            return expected;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, 0);\n        QueryResult qr = mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 5);\n    }\n\n    /** 无负载列的窄表（id, k），单字节行，用于精确估算磁盘额度。 */\n    private static Relation shortRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 0);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 40, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, 0);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void tinyQuotaThrowsDuringInitialPartitioning() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 200, 80, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 200, 80, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 8, 16, 128);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, 4096);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInLeftMarker() {\n        // 全热点、单分区 LEFT：进入热点分区时 build+probe 两份初始文件同时存活，\n        // BNL 在其基础上再申请 n 字节的标记位图。\n        // 额度取初始峰值（足够写初始分区），标记位图必然把 live 推过额度。\n        int n = 3000;\n        Relation l = shortRel(\"L\", n, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", n, 1, 0, 2);\n\n        QueryRequest measure = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, -1);\n        QueryResult mr = new HashJoinEngine(measure).execute(row -> { });\n        long peak = (Long) mr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\");\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(peak > 0, \"前置：应发生落盘\");\n\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, peak);\n        // 初始分区正好写满额度；n 字节标记位图再申请即耗尽\n        DiskQuotaException ex = expectQuota(failReq);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(ex.usedBytes() <= peak, \"已用字节不应超额度\");\n    }\n\n    private DiskQuotaException expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new HashJoinEngine(req).execute(row -> { });\n            TestRunner.fail(\"期望抛出 DiskQuotaException\");\n            return null;\n        } catch (DiskQuotaException expected) {\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.usedBytes() <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n            return expected;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, 0);\n phj.core.QueryRequest;\nimport phj.core.QueryResult;\nimport phj.core.Relation;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class DiskQuotaTest {\n\n    private static Relation mkRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 5);\n    }\n\n    /** 无负载列的窄表（id, k），单字节行，用于精确估算磁盘额度。 */\n    private static Relation shortRel(String name, int rows, int distinctKeys, int nullPct, long seed) {\n        return TestUtil.randomRelation(name, rows, distinctKeys, nullPct,\n                new java.util.Random(seed), false, 0);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaZeroThrowsOnSpill() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 100, 40, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 100, 40, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 4, 4, 0);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void tinyQuotaThrowsDuringInitialPartitioning() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 200, 80, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 200, 80, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 8, 16, 128);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInRecursiveSpill() {\n        // 高基数 + 极小阈值 -> 递归再分区时再次申请额度，给一个只够初轮的额度\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 400, 300, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 400, 300, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 2, 4, 4096);\n        expectQuota(req);\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaExhaustedInLeftMarker() {\n        // 全热点、单分区 LEFT：处理热点分区时 build+probe 两份初始文件同时存活，\n        // BNL 在其基础上再申请 n 字节的标记位图。\n        // 构造已知行数的窄行，精确计算“标记位图之前”的字节基线：\n        //   每行 \"[i,0]\\n\" 6 字节（i<10000），两侧共 2*6*n；标记位图 n 字节。\n        // 额度设为基线 + n/2：初始分区写得下，但标记位图差 n/2 字节而失败。\n        int n = 3000;\n        Relation l = shortRel(\"L\", n, 1, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = shortRel(\"R\", 1, 0, 2);\n        int lineBytes = 6;\n        long base = 2L * lineBytes * n;\n        long quota = base + n / 2;\n\n        QueryRequest failReq = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, List.of(\"k\"), 16, 1, quota);\n        DiskQuotaException ex = expectQuota(failReq);\n        TestRunner.assertTrue(ex.usedBytes() <= quota, \"已用字节不应超额度\");\n    }\n\n    private DiskQuotaException expectQuota(QueryRequest req) {\n        try {\n            new HashJoinEngine(req).execute(row -> { });\n            TestRunner.fail(\"期望抛出 DiskQuotaException\");\n            return null;\n        } catch (DiskQuotaException expected) {\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.usedBytes() <= expected.limitBytes(),\n                    \"异常时已用字节不应超过额度\");\n            TestRunner.assertTrue(expected.limitBytes() >= 0);\n            return expected;\n        }\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void quotaDoesNotAffectInMemory() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 4, 4, 0, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 4, 4, 0, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.INNER, List.of(\"k\"), 100, 4, 0);\n        QueryResult qr = TestUtil.assertAgainstReference(req);\n        TestRunner.assertEquals(0L, qr.stats.get(\"spillPeakBytes\"));\n    }\n\n    @Test\n    public void generousQuotaSucceeds() {\n        Relation l = mkRel(\"L\", 300, 60, 10, 1);\n        Relation r = mkRel(\"R\", 300, 60, 10, 2);\n        QueryRequest req = TestUtil.request(l, r, JoinType.LEFT, &lt;rightRows&gt; &lt;distinctKeys&gt; &lt;nullPct&gt; &lt;joinType&gt; [seed]\n * 例：\n *   java phj.DataGen 2000 1000 5 10 INNER 42\n *\n * distinctKeys=1 即“全热点键”场景；nullPct 为含 NULL 键行的百分比（0-100）。\n * 每行带一个负载列 payload，用于验证整行正确拼接。\n */\npublic final class DataGen {\n\n    private DataGen() {}\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length < 5) {\n            System.err.println(\"用法: DataGen <leftRows> <rightRows> <distinctKeys> <nullPct> <joinType> [seed]\");\n            System.exit(2);\n        }\n        int ln = Integer.parseInt(args[0]);\n        int rn = Integer.parseInt(args[1]);\n        int dk = Math.max(1, Integer.parseInt(args[2]));\n        int nullPct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Integer.parseInt(args[3])));\n        String joinType = args[4];\n        long seed = args.length > 5 ? Long.parseLong(args[5]) : 1L;\n        Random rnd = new Random(seed);\n\n        Map<String, Object> req = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        req.put(\"joinType\", joinType);\n        req.put(\"keys\", List.of(\"k\"));\n        req.put(\"left\", buildRelation(\"L\", ln, dk, nullPct, rnd, \"lv\"));\n        req.put(\"right\", buildRelation(\"R\", rn, dk, nullPct, rnd, \"rv\"));\n        Map<String, Object> opt = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        opt.put(\"memoryThresholdRows\", 8);\n        opt.put(\"diskQuotaBytes\", -1);\n        opt.put(\"exportPlan\", true);\n        req.put(\"options\", opt);\n        System.out.println(Json.writePretty(req));\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> buildRelation(String name, int n, int distinctKeys,\n                                                     int nullPct, Random rnd, String payloadPrefix) {\n        Map<String, Object> rel = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        rel.put(\"name\", name);\n        rel.put(\"columns\", List.of(\"id\", \"k\", payloadPrefix));\n        List<Object> rows = new ArrayList<>(n);\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            Object key;\n            if (rnd.nextInt(100) < nullPct) {\n                key = null;\n            } else {\n                key = (long) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);\n            }\n            rows.add(List.of((long) i, key, payloadPrefix + \"-\" + i));\n        }\n        rel.put(\"rows\", rows);\n        return rel;\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":62,"oldLines":7,"newStart":62,"newLines":8,"lines":["             } else {","                 key = (long) rnd.nextInt(distinctKeys);","             }","-            rows.add(List.of((long) i, key, payloadPrefix + \"-\" + i));","+            // 用 Arrays.asList 而非 List.of：行允许包含 null（NULL 键）","+            rows.add(java.util.Arrays.asList((Object) (long) i, key, payloadPrefix + \"-\" + i));","         }","         rel.put(\"rows\", rows);","         return rel;"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"acc7fd03-cc37-44e3-940e-3fbed223fb23","session_id":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a","sessionId":"78fbe3b7-950a-4e16-be06-a69ae1d55519","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp12-a","slug":"enumerated-puzzling-floyd"}

{"parentUuid":"a901bcc1-db24-4596-86e2-bdcec02af923","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_fguu55vs08uo7lw62igyyamy","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp12/a/README.md","content":"# 分区哈希连接（Partitioned Hash Join）纯后端\n\n单机、内存受限的查询引擎，核心运算**全部手写**（不依赖任何 SQL 引擎或第三方库），\n以 JSON 作为请求/响应格式，提供 **CLI** 与 **HTTP** 两种入口。支持：\n\n- `INNER` 内连接、`LEFT`（左外）连接；\n- 多列连接键，完整 **SQL NULL 语义**（键含 NULL 永不匹配，左连接补全 NULL 行）；\n- 建表侧超过内存阈值时**分区落盘**（Grace/Partitioned Hash Join）；\n- 热点分区（单一/高频键）**递归换种子再分区**，无法打散时走**有界回退**（分块嵌套循环 BNL）；\n- 重复键正确产生**笛卡尔积**；\n- **磁盘额度（字节配额）**限制与耗尽报错；\n- 执行计划、运行统计、溢写分区文件可导出。\n\n仅需 JDK 17+（开发与验证使用 JDK 21），零外部依赖、零构建工具。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 目录结构\n\n```\nsrc/main/java/phj/\n  json/        自写 JSON 解析/序列化（Json、JsonException）\n  core/        值模型 Value、多列键 Key、行 Row、关系 Relation、\n               连接类型 JoinType、键对 JoinKeyPair、请求/结果模型\n  join/        核心引擎 HashJoinEngine、嵌套循环参考实现 NestedLoopJoin、\n               溢写存储 SpillStore/SpillFile、磁盘位图 MarkerFile、\n               热点检测、有界回退、哈希路由 HashMix、统计收集\n  Main.java            CLI 入口\n  DataGen.java         样例数据生成器\n  QueryRunner.java     请求执行 / 响应组装 / 错误映射\n  server/HttpServerMain.java   内置 HTTP JSON 服务（JDK com.sun.net.httpserver）\ntest/phj/      自研轻量测试框架 + 7 个测试类（51 个用例）\nexamples/      请求样例与已保存的真实输出（examples/output）\nscripts/       build.sh / test.sh / run.sh / serve.sh\n```\n\n---\n\n## 2. 构建与运行\n\n```bash\n# 编译（产物在 out/classes）\n./scripts/build.sh\n\n# 运行全部自动化测试（51 个用例）\n./scripts/test.sh\n\n# 对一个请求文件执行连接\n./scripts/run.sh examples/inner-spill.json\n\n# 或从标准输入\ncat examples/left-spill-null.json | ./scripts/run.sh\n\n# 启动 HTTP 服务（默认 8080，可传端口；0 = 随机端口）\n./scripts/serve.sh 8080\n```\n\n### HTTP\n\n```bash\ncurl -s http://localhost:8080/health\ncurl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/query \\\n     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n     --data @examples/inner-spill.json\n```\n\n- `POST /query`：请求体为查询请求 JSON，响应体为查询响应 JSON。\n- HTTP 状态码：`200` 成功；`400` 请求非法；`507` 磁盘额度耗尽；`405/500` 其他。\n\n### CLI 退出码\n\n`0` 成功；`2` 请求非法（INVALID_REQUEST）；`3` 磁盘额度耗尽（DISK_QUOTA_EXCEEDED）；`1` 其他内部错误。\n\n### 样例数据生成器\n\n```bash\n# java phj.DataGen <leftRows> <rightRows> <distinctKeys> <nullPct> <joinType> [seed]\njava -cp out/classes phj.DataGen 2000 1000 5 10 INNER 42 > big.json\njava -cp out/classes phj.Main big.json\n```\n\n`distinctKeys=1` 即“全热点键”场景；`nullPct` 为含 NULL 键行的百分比。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 请求 / 响应 JSON 契约\n\n### 请求\n\n```json\n{\n  \"joinType\": \"INNER\",            // 或 \"LEFT\"\n  \"keys\": [\"k\"],                  // 左右同名列简写\n                                  // 多列 / 异名用配对：[[\"ka\",\"kra\"], [\"kb\",\"krb\"]]\n  \"left\":  { \"name\": \"orders\", \"columns\": [\"oid\",\"k\",\"amt\"],\n             \"rows\": [[1,\"a\",10],[2,null,20]] },\n  \"right\": { \"name\": \"customers\", \"columns\": [\"cid\",\"k\",\"city\"],\n             \"rows\": [[10,\"a\",\"BJ\"]] },\n  \"options\": {\n    \"memoryThresholdRows\": 4,     // 建表侧单分区可驻留内存的行数阈值\n    \"partitions\": 0,              // 初始分区数；0/AUTO = 按阈值估算\n    \"diskQuotaBytes\": -1,         // 溢写字节额度；-1 不限，0 完全禁止落盘\n    \"spillDir\": \"/tmp/phj\",       // 溢写根目录（默认 java.io.tmpdir）\n    \"keepSpillFiles\": false,      // true 保留分区 .jsonl 文件以便检查/导出\n    \"maxRecursiveLevels\": 16,     // 递归再分区最大层数\n    \"exportPlan\": true            // 响应中附带执行计划与统计\n  }\n}\n```\n\n标量类型：整数（JSON number 无小数 → LONG）、浮点（DOUBLE）、字符串、布尔、null。\nLONG 与 DOUBLE 按数值比较（`1` 与 `1.0` 相等）；字符串大小写敏感；跨族（数值/字符串/布尔）不相等。\n\n### 响应（成功）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"result\": {\n    \"columns\": [\"oid\",\"k\",\"amt\",\"cid\",\"k\",\"city\"],\n    \"rowCount\": 5,\n    \"rows\": [\n      { \"values\": [2,\"b\",20,12,\"b\",\"GZ\"],\n        \"asObject\": {\"oid\":2,\"k#1\":\"b\",\"amt\":20,\"cid\":12,\"k#4\":\"b\",\"city\":\"GZ\"} }\n    ]\n  },\n  \"executionPlan\": {\n    \"plan\":  { \"operator\": \"partitionedHashJoin\", \"...\": \"...\", \"children\": [ ... ] },\n    \"stats\": {\n      \"outputRows\": 5,\n      \"nullKeyBuildRowsDropped\": 1,\n      \"nullKeyProbeRows\": 1,\n      \"inMemoryPartitions\": 3,\n      \"spillWaves\": 1,\n      \"boundedFallbacks\": 0,\n      \"hotKeyFallbacks\": 0,\n      \"spillPeakBytes\": 120,\n      \"spillLiveBytesAtEnd\": 0,\n      \"diskQuotaBytes\": -1,\n      \"warnings\": []\n    },\n    \"spillDir\": \"...\"   // 仅 keepSpillFiles=true 时出现\n  }\n}\n```\n\n- 输出列顺序固定为 **左列在前、右列在后**。\n- 重名列在 `asObject` 中以 `列名#位置` 消歧（权威数据请看 `values` 数组）。\n- LEFT 无匹配时右侧列全部补 `null`。\n\n### 响应（失败）\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": false, \"errorType\": \"DISK_QUOTA_EXCEEDED\", \"errorCode\": 507,\n  \"error\": \"磁盘溢写额度耗尽……（额度 60 字节，已用 60 字节）\",\n  \"diskQuotaBytes\": 60, \"usedBytes\": 60 }\n```\n\n---\n\n## 4. 执行模型与关键设计\n\n### 4.1 总体流程\n\n1. **解析 / 校验**：键列按名解析为位置索引（重名键列报错）。\n2. **选建表侧**：\n   - `LEFT` 固定以**右表**为建表侧（保证每个左行都被探测、可补 NULL）；\n   - `INNER` 选择**行数较少**的一侧建表。\n3. 摘出含 NULL 键的行：**不进入哈希表、不参与分区落盘**。\n   - INNER 两侧 NULL 行均丢弃；LEFT 左表 NULL 行直接补 NULL 输出。\n4. **建表侧有效行数 ≤ 阈值** → 纯内存哈希连接（`HashMap<Key, List<Row>>`），无落盘。\n5. 否则进入分区流程（见 4.2）。\n\n### 4.2 分区落盘（Grace Hash Join）\n\n- 按哈希把建表侧、探测侧各切成 P 个分区，逐行以 **JSON Lines** 追加写入溢写文件。\n- 逐分区处理：\n  - 建表分区行数 ≤ 阈值：整分区读入建哈希表，探测侧**流式扫描**；\n    LEFT 用位图（小分区内存位图 / 大分区磁盘位图）记录探测行是否匹配，再补未匹配行。\n  - 建表分区超阈值：先做**热点检测**（流式统计不同键数与最高频键频次，键数过多提前终止）。\n- 递归与回退见 4.3。\n\n### 4.3 热点分区：递归再分区 / 有界回退\n\n- **可打散**（多个不同键、无单一键超阈值）：换层种子重新哈希成更多子分区，递归处理，\n  层数上限 `maxRecursiveLevels`。\n- **不可打散**（全分区单一热点键，或某键频次本身已超阈值）或达到层数上限：\n  进入 **有界回退 = 分块嵌套循环（Block Nested Loop）**：\n  - 建表侧**流式切块**（每块 ≤ 阈值行），逐块建哈希表并扫描一遍探测侧；\n  - 内存驻留上界 ≈ 阈值行的建表数据 + 哈希表开销，探测侧始终流式、不整块载入；\n  - LEFT 用与探测行数等大的**磁盘位图标记文件**（`.mark`，1 字节/行）记录匹配，\n    所有块扫完后再流式扫一遍探测侧，输出未匹配行并补 NULL。\n\n### 4.4 三个容易出错、已被测试钉死的正确性点\n\n1. **分区路由哈希必须与连接匹配哈希同源。**\n   连接判定允许 LONG/DOUBLE 数值跨型相等（`1` = `1.0`），\n   因此分区路由直接使用 `Key.hashCode()`（与 `Key.equals` 满足 hashCode/equals 契约），\n   再叠加每层不同的种子做扰动。绝不能另写一套哈希，否则数值跨型相等的键会被\n   拆到不同分区而漏匹配（早期版本确实踩过，被 `fuzzManyThresholdsPartitions` 抓到）。\n2. **NULL 语义分层。**\n   - 连接键判定（`Key.equals`）：SQL 三值逻辑，NULL 与 NULL 也不相等；\n   - 结果行的多重集比较（`Row.equals`）：数据语义，同位置 NULL 视为相等。\n   二者刻意区分，各自的 hashCode 都与自身 equals 保持一致。\n3. **笛卡尔积。** 哈希表按 Key 聚成 `List<Row>`，探测命中时输出两侧全部行组合。\n\n### 4.5 磁盘额度\n\n`SpillStore` 对所有溢写（分区 `.jsonl` 按 UTF-8 字节累计、左连接 `.mark` 位图按行数）\n做统一字节预留；超过 `diskQuotaBytes` 立即抛 `DiskQuotaException`（携带额度与已用字节），\n不会先写超再报错。默认（`-1`）不限。`keepSpillFiles=true` 时保留分区文件供检查，\n但内部 `.mark` 位图始终删除。\n\n### 4.6 流式输出\n\n`HashJoinEngine.execute(RowSink)` 逐行推送结果，不缓存结果集——\n已用 1 亿输出行（10000×10000 全热点）在 `-Xmx64m` 下验证不 OOM。\n无参 `execute()` 与 CLI/HTTP 默认仍收集为完整 JSON 响应。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 自动化测试\n\n自研零依赖迷你框架（`@Test` + 反射 + 断言），`scripts/test.sh` 一键运行。**共 51 个用例，全部通过。**\n\n| 测试类 | 覆盖内容 |\n|---|---|\n| `JsonTest` | JSON 解析/转义/Unicode/错误输入/round-trip |\n| `EngineSemanticsTest` | NULL 语义、多列键、LONG/DOUBLE 跨型、笛卡尔积、空表、建表侧选择、补 NULL 列宽 |\n| `SpillMechanicsTest` | 落盘触发/不触发、保留与清理、递归再分区、全热点 BNL、左连接位图（内存/磁盘）、分区数配置 |\n| `CorrectnessFuzzTest` | **260 个随机用例 + 阈值×分区矩阵 60 例 + 24 个大全热点 + 40 个多列键**，全部与嵌套循环参考实现做**多重集比对** |\n| `DiskQuotaTest` | 额度 0、初始分区耗尽、递归阶段耗尽、左连接标记位图耗尽、内存路径不受额度影响、宽限额度成功 |\n| `CliEndToEndTest` | 子进程 CLI：stdin/文件输入、退出码 0/2/3、错误类型、计划导出 |\n| `HttpServerTest` | 进程内真实 HTTP：/health、/query 200/400/507/405 |\n\n验收要求的场景均有对应用例：\n\n- **多重集比对**：`TestUtil.assertMultisetEquals` 以行频次（HashMap）比较，顺序无关、重复次数敏感；\n  每个模糊用例都同时跑 `HashJoinEngine` 与 `NestedLoopJoin`（朴素 O(N·M) 无前端（按要求只做后端）。\n- 仅等值连接（equi-join）的 INNER / LEFT；未实现 RIGHT/FULL/SEMI/ANTI、非等值条件、投影下推、聚合。\n- 内存阈值以“**建表行数**”刻画（题目以内存阈值表述），不是字节级精确内存计量；真正的内存上界保证来自\n  “建表分区 ≤ 阈值才整体驻留 + BNL 每块 ≤ 阈值 + 探测侧流式”。\n- 单机单线程执行（HTTP 请求线程池除外），无并行分区、无网络 shuffle。\n- 溢写文件用 JSON Lines 文本格式（可读、易导出），体积/速度不如二进制列式格式。\n- JSON 数字：整数解析为 LONG、含小数/指数为 DOUBLE；超大整数会退化为 double
